so.seo.introLocation.description: Munib Tracker waxay isticmaashaa goobta iyo ogeysiisyada waqtiyo sax ah oo salaad, qibla, iyo xusuusin ikhtiyaari ah. Dambe waxaad ka beddeli kartaa Dejinta.
so.zakat.deductionsCardHint: Deyn degdeg ah (iyo kharashka nolosha oo keliya haddii aqoonyahankaagu oggolaado).
so.zakat.groupHint.investments: Kaydka, badeecooyinka ganacsiga, rasiidhada, iyo dakhliga ganacsiga ee la badbaadiyey ee qiimaha maanta.
so.zakat.groupHint.liquid: Lacag caddaan ah, crypto, iyo qiyamka birta ah ee aad hore u ogeyd. Ama ku isticmaal miisaanka kaadhka birta.
so.zakat.livestock.cardHint: Miisaanka xayawaanka sunnada - maaha 2.5%. Qiimaha lacagta caddaanka ah ee ikhtiyaarka ah ee qiyaasaha kaliya.
so.zakat.sectionInfo.agriculture.body: Sakada dalaggu waxay ku beegan tahay xilliga la goosanayo, ma aha ka dib sannad dayax. Qiimaha la og yahay waa 10% (ushr) marka dhulka uu waraabiyo roob ama ilo, iyo 5% marka waraabka uu ku baxo kharash ama lacag. Geli qiimihii suuqa goosashada xilligaan oo dooro isha biyaha ee xaaladaada ku habboon.
so.zakat.sectionInfo.agriculture.localRefEx: And He is the One Who produces gardens, trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [flavours], and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of their fruit when they bear fruit, and give its due on the day of its harvest…
so.zakat.sectionInfo.agriculture.title: Beeraha & Goynta (ushr)
so.zakat.sectionInfo.currency.body: Sakada waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa qiimaha suuqa ee hantidaada lacag aad fahmi karto. Qiimaha dahabka iyo qalinka ah waxay caawiyaan qiyaasida nisab iyo qiyamka birta - waxay muujinayaan, maaha bedelka sicirka suuqyada maxaliga ah ee uu isticmaalo aqoonyahankaaga.
so.zakat.sectionInfo.currency.title: Lacagta & qiimayaasha
so.zakat.sectionInfo.deductions.body: Sakadu waxay ku jirtaa hantida saafiga ah ee zakadu. Deynta degdega ah ee hadda jirta ayaa inta badan laga jaraa ka hor inta aan la codsan 2.5%. Deymaha muddada-dheer si taxadar leh ayaa loola dhaqmaa - aqoonyahanno badan oo casri ah ayaa ka jaraa kaliya lacagaha sanadka soo socda, ma aha dhammaan baaqyada. Kharashaadka nolosha ee isla markiiba waa la ogol yahay haddii aqoonyahankaagu kuu ogolaado.
so.zakat.sectionInfo.deductions.title: Ka jarista
so.zakat.sectionInfo.investments.body: Badeecooyinka ganacsiga, baayacmushtarka, iyo hantida loogu talagalay in la beero ayaa guud ahaan sakada laga qaadi karaa qiimaha suuqa ee maanta. Saamiyada iyo lacagaha waxaa caadi ahaan loo qiimeeyaa sida hantida ganacsiga. Risiidhada xooggan ee aad filayso inaad ururiso ayaa inta badan lagu daraa. Qur'aanka 2:267 wuxuu ku boorinayaa inaad wax ka bixiso wanaaga waxaad kasbatay - si daacad ah u qiimee taariikhda zakada.
so.zakat.sectionInfo.investments.title: Maalgelinta & ganacsiga
so.zakat.sectionInfo.liquid.body: Lacag caddaan ah, hadhaaga bangiga, iyo dahab ama qalin loo haysto hanti ahaan ayaa ka mid ah hantida ugu cad cad ee zakada ah. Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu si adag uga digay in laga reebo wixii ku waajib ah dahabka iyo lacagta. Dahabka loo xidho isticmaalka caadiga ah waa barta la og yahay ee farqiga u dhexeeya dugsiyada - raac madhabtaada. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad halkan ku geliso qiimo lacageed, ama waxaad ku xisaabin kartaa biraha miisaan ahaan qaybta xigta.
so.zakat.sectionInfo.liquid.title: Lacag caddaan ah & biraha qaaliga ah
so.zakat.sectionInfo.livestock.body: Idaha, ariga, lo'da, iyo geela daaqa xorta ah waxay leeyihiin miisaan sunne ah iyo nisaab u gaar ah (sida 40 neef oo ido ah, 30 lo' ah, 5 geel ah) - maaha heerka lacagta 2.5%. Kharashka waxaa badanaa lagu bixiyaa xoolaha da'da cayiman. Xayawaanka daaqsinka ah ee loo hayo ganacsi ahaan inta badan waxay raacaan shuruucda badeecadaha. Qiimaha lacagta caddaanka ah ee ikhtiyaarka ah halkan waa qiyaas qorshayn oo keliya.
so.zakat.sectionInfo.livestock.title: Xoolaha (adhiga daaqaya)
so.zakat.sectionInfo.metals.body: Nisaabku waxa uu sunnada ku go'ay miisaan ahaan: ilaa 20 diinaar oo dahab ah ama 200 dirham oo qalin ah (oo inta badan lagu sheego ~ 87.5 g dahab ah ama ~ 612 g qalin ah). Karaat iyo daahirnimo waa arrin sababtoo ah sakadu waxay ku jirtaa macdanta saafiga ah. Sicirka nooluhu waa 24k/Bir Fiican halkii garaam — dooro unuggaaga (gram, tola, troy oz) iyo karat si xisaabiyuhu si sax ah ugu beddelo.
so.zakat.sectionInfo.metals.title: Dahab & qalin miisaan ahaan
so.zakat.sectionInfo.nisab.body: Nisaabku waa tariikhda ugu yar ka hor inta aan la bixin sakada maalka. Rasuulku (scw) wuxuu hagaajiyay 20 diinaar oo dahab ah ama 200 dirham oo lacag ah, wuxuuna baray inaan sakada lagu waajibin ilaa sanad uu dhaafo xoolaha. Sababtoo ah qiimaha dahabka iyo qalinku way kala duwan yihiin maanta, aqoonyahanno badan ayaa doorbidaya heerka hoose (inta badan lacagta) si in badan oo saboolka ah loo caawiyo. Xisaabiyahani waxa uu soo jeedinayaa hoose ee labada qiyaasood ee nool
so.zakat.sectionInfo.nisab.title: Xadka Nisab
so.zakat.sectionInfo.property.body: Gurigaaga gaarka ah, gaarigaaga gaarka ah, iyo alaabta guriga ee caadiga ah guud ahaan ma ahan sakado - sakadu waxay beegsataa maalka sii kordhaya, ee ma aha alaabta la isticmaalo. Shirqoollada, guryaha, ama baabuurta loo haysto maalgashiga, iibinta, ama ganacsiga ayaa laga yaabaa in lagu daro qiimaha suuqa (ama xaddi hore loo bixiyay goobo maalgashi oo qayb-qayb ah). Marka aanad hubin, weydii aqoonyahan.

so.laylatAlQadr.intro: Laylatul-qadrigu waxa ay ku dhex qarsoon tahay habeennada qallafsan ee tobanka dambe ee Ramadaan, oo aan hal timir loo cayimin. Ku raadi cibaadada daacada ah dhamaantood halkii aad ka heli lahayd hal habeen oo la qiyaasayo.

so.newMuslim.intro: Ku soo dhawaada Islaamka. Hagahan waxa uu daboolayaa shahada, shanta tiir, aasaaska iimaanka, iyo marka hore eegno salaadda, ka dib waxa uu kuu tilmaamayaa Salaax, Aqidah, iyo hagayaasha Qur’aanka kariimka ah ee App-kan ku jira.

so.zakat.guide.debts.body:
Sakada waxa lagu xisaabiyaa maalkaada saafiga ah ee zakadu, markaa deymaha dhabta ah ee lagugu leeyahay waxa ay kaa dhimi kartaa lacagta aad bixinayso. Arrinka ugu cadi waa deymaha la leeyahay hadda - deyn shakhsi ah oo aan la bixin, hadhaaga kaadhka-kredit-ka, kirada ama biilasha hore loogu lahaa. Culumada badankoodu waxay ogolaadaan kuwan in laga jaro hantidaada guud ka hor inta aanad codsan 2.5%.

Deynta muddada dheer sida dayn-qaadista ama qorshaha qayb-qaybsiga sannadaha badan waxa loo maareeyaa si taxadar leh, sababtoo ah haddii la jaro dhammaan baaqyada waxay tirtiraysaa sakada ku dhawaad ​​qof kasta oo amaah guri ku leh. Habka caadiga ah ee casriga ah waa in laga jaro kaliya lacagaha ku waajibay sanadka soo socda, ee maaha wadarta guud ee dhiman. Dugsiyada iyo aqoonyahanadu way ku kala duwan yihiin halkan, markaa dooro hab joogto ah oo hoos yimaada hagida.

Laba digtoonaan. Marka hore, ha ula macaamilin kharashaadka mustaqbalka ama mala-awaalka ah sidii deymo laga jari karo - kaliya waxa dhab ahaantii lagugu leeyahay ayaa la tiriyaa. Midda labaad, sakada aan la bixin sannadkii hore ha ka goynina sidii dayn caadi ah; sakada aan la bixin ayaa hadhsan waajib xaq ah oo waa in si fudud loo bixiyo. Marka xaaladda deyntaadu ay adag tahay, xukunka aqoonyahanku wuxuu ka qiimo badan yahay male-awaal adag.

so.zakat.guide.mistakes.body:
Xitaa Muslimiinta daacadda ah waxay inta badan simbiriirixan tafatirka dhabta ah ee sakada. Ogaanshaha khaladaadka caadiga ah waxay kaa caawineysaa inaad si sax ah u bixiso oo maskaxda ku hayso.

Illowda hawl ama sannad-guurada: bixinta wakhti aan kala sooc lahayn, ama ka boodi sannado, waxay ka tagtaa waajibaad muuqda. Sannad kasta hagaaji hal taariikh oo Hijri ah oo ku qiimee hantidaada.

Hantida oo si khaldan loo tiriyo: ku qiimeeya dahabka ama saamiyada qiimihii ay ku iibsadeen halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen qiimaha suuqa ee maanta, illowda lacagta caddaanka ah ee lagu hayo xisaabaadka ama lacagaha badan, ama iska indho tirka alaabada ganacsiga iyo lacagta lagugu leeyahay. Sakadu waxay saarantahay wax kasta oo zakada ah oo aad leedahay taariikhdaada.

Siinta dadka khaldan: u dhiibista sakada waalidiinta, carruurta, ama xaaska aad hore u taageertay, ama ula dhaqanto sida deeq guud oo loogu talagalay arrin kasta oo wanaagsan. Waa in ay gaadho sideed ka mid ah qaybaha Qur'aanka.

Khaladaadka niyada: in si deeqsinimo ah loo bixiyo sanadka oo dhan laakiin aan waligeed la rabin in mid ka mid ah sako ahaan. Sakadu waa cibaado waxayna u baahan tahay niyada (niyyah) in bixintan gaarka ahi ay tahay zakada waajibka ah.

Deymaha oo si xad dhaaf ah loo jaro: laga jaro daynta muddada dheer oo dhan, ama kharashyada mustaqbalka ee aan weli lagu lahayn, si loo yareeyo biilka. Kaliya deymaha dhabta ah ee hadda jira ayaa dhimaya hantidaada zakada ah. Marka mid ka mid ah kuwan aanu u caddayn xaaladdaada, weydii aqoonyahan aqoon u leh halkii aad ka qaadan lahayd.
so.zakat.guide.purpose.body:
Eebe wuxuu yidhi isagoo ka hadlaya sakada: "Ka qaad xoolahooda sadaqo aad ku daahirisaan oo aad korinaysaan" (Qur'an 9:103). Waajibku wuxuu u shaqeeyaa laba heer oo kala ah hal mar - waxay ka nadiifisaa nafta bixiyaha bakhaylnimada iyo jacaylka adduunka, waxayna nadiifisaa hantida lafteeda si waxa gacantaada ku jira ay u noqdaan kuwo caafimaad leh oo barakeysan.

Bulsho ahaan, sakadu waa hannaan wareeg ah oo Eebbe amray. Nabigu (scw) markuu Mucaad u diray Yaman wuxuu faray in sakada laga qaado maalkooda lana siiyo masaakiintooda. Maalku maaha in wax yar lagu ururiyo; Sakadu waxay dib u soo jiidataa dhaqdhaqaaq si ay u quudiyaan masaakiinta, daynta laga xoreeyo, iyo xoojinta curaarta bulshada.

Ruux ahaan, bixinta sakadu waa mahadnaq iyo kalsooni. Waxay ka jawaabaysaa rabitaanka bini'aadamka si ay u xifdiyaan si hubaal ah in arzuqa xagga Eebe ka yimid, waxayna ku tababartaa mu'minka jacaylka wax bixinta. Qofka sakada bixiya si badheedh ah wuxuu helayaa xoolihiisa oo la dhawray, qalbigooduna u fudaydiyay, abaalkoodana Eebahood agtiisa ayuu ku kaydsan yahay- “wax cabsi ah oo korkooda ah ma jiro, mana murugoodo” (Qur’an 2:277).
so.zakat.guide.recipients.body:
Sakada waxa la siin karaa oo keliya qaybaha dadka uu Eebbe laftiisu ku magacaabay suuradda at-Tawbah (9:60). Tani waa mid ka mid ah cibaadada dhawrka ah ee cibaadada ay ku hagaajiyaan waxyiga, ee aan looga tagin dookha bixiyaha. Sideeda qaybood waa: faqiir (al-fuqara); kuwa baahan (al-masakin); kuwa u shaqeeya ururinta iyo bixinta sakada; kuwa quluubtooda la heshiisiinayo (al-mucalafah); sii daynta maxaabiista iyo kuwa addoonsiga ah (fi'r-riqab); daynta-culus (al-garimin); Dariiqa Allaah (fi sabil Allaah); iyo musaafirkii go'doonsanaa ( ibn as-sabiil).

Looma baahna in la siiyo dhammaan sideeda; Sakada aad siiso xitaa hal qeybood oo aad xaq u leedahay ayaa gudaneysa waajibka, una jihaynta miskiinka iyo masaakiinta ayaa ah dhaqanka ugu badan.

Sidoo kale waxaa muhiim ah cidda aan helin. Sakada lama siin karo dadka hodanka ah, iyo kuwa ay kugu waajibtay inaad taageerto - waalidkaa, carruurtaada, ama xaaskaaga - sababtoo ah taageeridda iyaga waa waajib lagugu leeyahay. Aragtida qadiimiga ah waa wareejinta shakhsi ahaaneed ee lahaanshaha shaqsi u qalma, maaha deeq guud; Culimadu waxay ku kala aragti duwan yihiin in machadyada sida masaajidda ama mashaariicda guud ee dadweynaha ay u qalmaan dar Alle. Sidoo kale lama siin karo qoyska Nebiga ﷺ, reer banuu Haashim, sakada ahaan. Si badheedh ah ulajeedo dadka ku habboon qaybaha Qur'aanka.

so.qaza.witrNote.intro: Sida ay qabaan culimada inteeda badan, samaynta Witr ee seegay waa la oggol yahay, laakiin haddii loo baahan yahay waxay ku xidhan tahay madhabtaada (dugsiga fikirka).
so.qaza.witrNote.hanafiBody: Witr waa waajib (waajib). Haddii aad seegto, waa inaad sameysaa (qaza). U ducee isla markaad xasuusato - xitaa haddii maalmo ama toddobaadyo ay dhaafeen. Tani waa aragtida ay raacaan inta badan Muslimiinta ku nool Koonfurta Aasiya, Aasiyada Dhexe, iyo Turkiga.
so.qaza.witrNote.othersBody: Witr waa sunne si adag loo adkeeyay (sunnah mu'akkadah), ma aha waajib. Samaynta ayaa lagu talinayaa (mustahabb) laakiin looma baahna. Nebigu ﷺ wuxuu samayn jiray salaadda habeenka ee seexda hurdo ama jirro awgeed.
so.qaza.witrNote.evidenceBody: Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu yidhi: "Qofkii seexda oo seega Witr ama illoobay, ha tukaday markuu xasuusto." (Tirmidhi, Ibnu Maajah — culimadu way ku kala aragti duwan yihiin darajada ay leedahay) Saxiix Muslim markuu ku dhaafo salaadda habeenka xanuun ama hurdo awgeed, wuxuu maalintii ku soo qaatay tiro rakcadood ah.
so.qaza.witrNote.footer: Abkan waxa uu u tiriyaa kuwa seegay Witr dhanka qaza dhamaan isticmaalayaasha Ula dhaqan sida loo baahan yahay haddii aad raacdo aragtida Hanafi; Haddii kale u raac sida qurxinta lagu taliyey. La tasho aqoonyahan xaaladaada.

so.zakat.evidenceSubtitle: Qoraalada aasaasiga ah ee dejinaya sakada oo ah waajib
so.zakat.evidenceIntro: Sakada waxaa lagu aasaasay Qur'an iyo Sunnah sida waajibaad go'an oo ku saabsan hantida u qalmidda - maaha samafal ikhtiyaari ah.
so.zakat.guide.basics.body:
Sakadu waa tiirka saddexaad ee Islaamka, oo fadhiya inta u dhaxaysa salaadda (salah) iyo soonka Ramadan. Qur'an amarka ah in la oogo salaadda iyo bixinta sakada ayaa lagu celceliyay marar badan iyadoo hal lammaane ah - taas oo muujinaysa in cibaadada Allah iyo daryeelka makhluuqaadkiisa ay isku xidhan yihiin. Ma aha hadiyad ikhtiyaari ah, laakiin waa mid go'an oo xaq ah in miskiinku ku haysto hantida taajiriinta.

Erayga sakada macnihiisu waa daahirin iyo korriin labadaba. Bixinta qayb yar oo go'an oo macaashka ah waxay ka nadiifisaa hantidaada inteeda kale iyo qalbigaaga hunguriga, iyo - ballanqaadka Allah - waxay sababtaa waxa hadha inay u koraan barako halkii ay hoos u dhici lahaayeen.

Heerka caadiga ah ee hantida lacageed waa hal-40-aad, taas oo ah 2.5%. Markaa 1,000kiiba ee hantida u qalma ee dhammaystay sannad-dugsiyeedkeeda oo ka sarreeya heerka ugu sarreeya, 25 ayaa ku habboon. Tani waa saami yar oo nakhshad leh: ku filan in lagu wareejiyo agabka kuwa u baahan iyada oo aan la dhibin bixiyaha.

Sakada la mid ma aha. Sadaqah waa sadaqo kasta oo iskaa wax u qabso ah, oo la siiyo qadar kasta, wakhti kasta, ku dhawaad ​​qof kasta. Sakadu waa waajib qeexan - qiime go'an, oo ku saabsan qaybaha hantida, marka la buuxiyo shuruudaha, la bixiyo si loo dejiyo qaybaha dadka. In si ula kac ah loo dayaco waa dembi culus; Labada Qur'an iyo Sunnadu waxay si adag uga digayaan in la ururiyo hantida iyada oo laga reebayo xuquuqdeeda.
so.zakat.guide.purpose.title: Waa maxay sababta sakada - ujeedada & xigmadda
so.zakat.guide.purpose.summary: Waxay nadiifisaa maalka iyo nafta, miskiinkana way korisaa
so.zakat.guide.hawl.summary: Maalku waa inuu ka sarreeyaa nisab hal sano Hijri
so.zakat.guide.hawl.body:
Sakada lacagta caddaanka ah, dahabka, qalinka, iyo hantida ganacsiga ayaa guud ahaan sabab u ah ka dib marka hantidaasi ay ku harto ama ka sareyso heerka nisab hal sano oo dhamaystiran Hijri (lunar), oo loo yaqaan hawl. Nebigu ﷺ wuxuu baray in aan sakada laga bixin maalka ilaa uu sannad ka soo wareego.

Ficil ahaan, u fiirso taariikhda hantidaada zakada ah ay markii ugu horeysay gaartay nisab. Taariikhdaasi waxay noqonaysaa sannad-guuradii zakada- sannad kasta, isla taariikhdaas Hijri, waxaad qiimeysaa wax kasta oo aad leedahay oo bixi 2.5% wadarta guud.

Uma baahnid inaad lacag kasta si gaar ah ula socoto. Culumada badankoodu waxay qabaan in ilaa inta wadartaadu ay sii jirto ama ka sarayso nisab sanadka oo dhan, wax yar oo kac ah iyo kor u kaca inta u dhaxaysa waxba maaha - waxaad si fudud u qiimeysaa wadarta guud ee sannad-guuradaada. Haddii hantidaadu gabi ahaanba hoos uga dhacdo nisab inta lagu jiro sanadka, aqoonyahanno badan ayaa tixgeliya hawl si ay dib u dejiyaan, dib u bilaabaan kaliya marka aad gaarto nisab.

Xusuusnow in sanadka Hijri (lunar) uu qiyaastii kow iyo toban maalmood ka gaaban yahay sanadka qoraxda. Haddii aad door bidayso inaad ku bixiso wakhti go'an oo Gregorian ah si ay kuugu habboonaato, culimada qaarkood ayaa kuu oggolaanaya inay wax yar kordhiso qiimaha lagu xisaabinayo wareegga gaaban ee dayaxa. Wax-soo-saarka beeraha iyo xooluhu waxay raacaan xeerar u gaar ah oo waqtiyeysan oo isku si kuma xirna hawl.
so.zakat.guide.nisab.title: Nisab - heerka ugu hooseeya
so.zakat.guide.nisab.summary: Lagu cabbiray ~ 87.5 g dahab ah ama ~ 595-612 g oo qalin ah
so.zakat.guide.nisab.body:
Nisab waa hantida ugu yar ee uu qofku haysto ka hor intaysan sakada ku waajibin. Qofkii hantidiisa saafiga ah ay ka hooseyso nisab sanadka oo dhan wax sako ah laguma leh - waajibku wuxuu saaran yahay oo keliya kuwa haysta faa'iido dheeraad ah.

Rasuulku ﷺ wuxuu ku hagaajiyay marinnada laga soo galo waqtigiisii: 20 diinaar oo dahab ah ama 200 dirham oo qalin ah. Miisaan ahaan tani waxay ka shaqeysaa qiyaastii 85-87.5 g oo dahab ah, iyo qiyaastii 595-612 g oo qalin ah (kala duwanaanshaha yar wuxuu ka tarjumayaa beddelka cilmiyeed ee kala duwan ee dirhamka). Xisaabiyahani waxa uu isticmaalaa tirooyin la soo xigtay oo ku saabsan 87.48 g dahab ah iyo 612.36 g oo qalin ah.

Sababtoo ah dahabka iyo lacagta mar dambe ma ka ganacsanayaan saamiga ay ku sameeyeen xilligii Nabiga, labada marin hadda waxay bixiyaan qiime lacageed oo aad u kala duwan - lacagta nisab waa mid aad u hooseeya. Aqoonyahano badan oo casri ah ayaa sidaas darteed kugula taliya in lagu cabbiro lacagta caddaanka ah iyo hantida isku dhafan ee ka soo horjeeda lacagta nisab: waxay ka dhigaysaa dad badan oo masuul ah, laakiin taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay in badan oo saboolka ah ayaa la caawiyaa, taas oo ah ruuxa waajibaadka. Kuwa kale waxay raacaan dahabka nisab. Labada mawqifba waa la ixtiraamaa - raac tilmaamaha aqoonyahankaaga.
so.zakat.guide.zakatable.title: Waa maxay guud ahaan zakada
so.zakat.guide.zakatable.summary: Lacag caddaan ah, biraha, maalgashiga, alaabta ganacsiga, rasiidhada
so.zakat.guide.zakatable.body:
Sakada waxa sabab u ah hantida awood u leh in ay koraan - lacagta iyo waxyaabaha loo haysto lacag ahaan - halkii aad ka ahaan lahayd alaabta aad si fudud u isticmaasho. Qaybaha ugu muhiimsan ee lagu heshiiyey guud ahaan dugsiyadu waa lacag caddaan ah, dahab iyo qalin, badeecado ganacsi, iyo (oo leh xeerar iyaga u gaar ah) dalagga iyo xoolaha.

Sida caadiga ah sakada maanta: lacag caddaan ah oo gacanta ku jirta iyo xisaabaadka bangiyada; dahab iyo qalin, oo ay ku jiraan dibi, qadaadiic, iyo waxyaalaha la isku qurxiyo ee aan si joogto ah loo isticmaalin; saamiyada, saamiyada, iyo maalgelinta wadaagga ah ee lagu qiimeeyay qiimaha suuqa ay hadda ku sugan yihiin; badeecooyinka iyo agabka ganacsiga (alaabta ganacsiga), oo lagu qiimeeyay qiimaha iibka; rasiidhada xooggan - deymaha iyo qaansheegyada aad si macquul ah u filayso inaad ururiso; iyo dakhliga kiraynta ama ganacsiga aad kaydsatay intii aad isticmaali lahayd.

Culimo badan ayaa sidoo kale ka mid ah kaydka hawlgabka la heli karo iyo cryptocurrencies loo haysto hanti ahaan, iyaga oo ula dhaqmaya sida lacag caddaan ah ama maalgashi. Marka shaki la galo, su'aasha hagitaanku waa sahlan tahay: hantidani ma kayd qiimo leh mise hab korriin oo aan baabi'in karo? Hadday sidaas tahay, waxay u badan tahay in sako la bixin karo. Wax kasta ku qiimee qiimaha suuqa ee maanta taariikhda sakada - maahan waxaad markii hore bixisay.
so.zakat.guide.exempt.title: Waxa inta badan aan sakada laga qaadin
so.zakat.guide.exempt.summary: Alaabta shakhsi ahaaneed loo isticmaalo, dahab la gashado, hawlgab qufulan
so.zakat.guide.exempt.body:
Hantida ku xidhan nolol maalmeedkaaga caadiga ah guud ahaan ma aha sakada, sababtoo ah sakadu waxay beegsataa maalka sii kordhaya ee maaha waxyaabaha aad la nooshahay oo aad isticmaasho. Gurigaaga, baabuurkaaga, dharkaaga, alaabta gurigaaga, qalabkaaga, iyo qalabka iyo qalabka ganacsigaaga dhamaantood waa laga dhaafay - si kasta oo ay qiimo u leeyihiin.

Dahabka iyo dahabka dahabka ah ee ay gabadhu si joogto ah u xidhato ayaa ah farqi caan ah oo la yaqaan. Dugsiga Hanafi wuxuu qabtaa in dhammaan dahabka iyo qalinka ay yihiin sakada xitaa haddii la xidho; Aqlabiyadda - Maliki, Shafi'i, iyo Hanbali - dahabka laga dhaafo si loogu isticmaalo isticmaalka shakhsi ahaaneed ee caadiga ah laakiin ku dara haddii loo kaydiyo sida kayd hanti ah ama ka badan tahay qurxinta dhaqameed. Raac xukunka dugsiga aad raacdo.

Lacagta hawlgabka ama lacagta hawl-gabka ah ee aanad weli heli karin inta badan waa laga saarayaa ilaa lacagtu ay dhab ahaantii ku soo gasho gacantaada, inkasta oo culimada qaarkood ay u baahan yihiin sakada qaybta la heli karo. Deymaha lagugu leeyahay ee aan loo badnayn in la bixiyo inta badan lama xisaabiyo ilaa laga soo kabsado. Sida had iyo jeer, tafaasiisha ugu fiican way ku kala duwan yihiin dugsiyada - marka kiisku aanu caddayn, weydii aqoonyahan u qalma halkii aad qiyaasi lahayd.
so.zakat.guide.debts.title: Deymaha & dhimista
so.zakat.guide.debts.summary: Deynta degdega ah waa laga jari karaa ka hor inta aan la xisaabin 2.5%
so.zakat.guide.recipients.summary: Sideed qaybood oo lagu magacaabay Qur'an 9:60
so.zakat.guide.otherRates.summary: Dalagga, xoolaha, iyo ciidda ka hor zakat al-fitr way kala duwan yihiin
so.zakat.guide.otherRates.body:
Qiimaha 2.5% wuxuu khuseeyaa lacagta iyo hantida ganacsiga - zakat al-mal, kaas oo xisaabiyahani daboolayo. Dhawr qaybood oo kale ayaa leh gabi ahaanba sharciyo iyo qiimayaal kala duwan.

Dalagyada iyo miraha waxay leeyihiin sakada marka la goosto, ma aha sannad ka dib: qiimaha waa 10% (ushr) dhulka sida dabiiciga ah u waraabiyo roobka ama ilo, iyo 5% dhulka lagu waraabiyo dadaal macmal ah ama kharash. Xoolaha daaqa - geela, lo'da, idaha, iyo riyaha si xor ah u daaqaya sannadka intiisa badan - waxay leeyihiin noocyo u gaar ah oo noocyo kala duwan ah nisab tirinta iyo miisaanka simbiriirrada, oo si toos ah looga soo qaatay Sunnada.

Zakat al-fitr wuu ka duwan yahay mar kale, qof kasta oo Muslim ahna waa inuu ogaadaa. Waa sadaqo yar oo go'an - qiyaastii hal sa' (qiyaastii 2.5-3 kg) ee cuntada daruuriga ah sida timirta, shaciir, qamadi, ama bariis, ama qiimaheeda lacag caddaan ah oo xukunno badan ah - oo ay ugu wacan tahay dhammaadka Ramadan isagoo ka wakiil ah xubin kasta oo qoyska ah, yar iyo weynba. Ujeeddadeedu waa in qofka sooman laga nadiifiyo wax kasta oo dhiman iyo in la hubiyo in masaakiinta ay sidoo kale helaan cunto ay ku ciidaan. Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu amray in la bixiyo inta aan la tukan salaadda Ciidul Fidriga; Ka dib lacagta la bixiyo waxay ku xisaabtamaysaa oo keliya samafal caadi ah. Mid kasta oo ka mid ah qaybahan wuxuu leeyahay xukuno faahfaahsan oo u gaar ah - raadso hagitaan u gaar ah hantida.
so.zakat.guide.mistakes.title: Khaladaadka caadiga ah si looga fogaado
so.zakat.guide.mistakes.summary: Khaladaadka ka dhigaya sakada mid buray ama xisaab qaldan laga dhigay
so.zakat.nisabWeightNote: Miisaanka saxda ah iyo birta la door bidayo wax yar bay ku kala duwan yihiin dugsiyada. Xisaabiyaha ayaa isticmaala tirooyinkan si weyn loo soo xigtay ee Hanafi.
so.zakat.fieldHint.cash: Xisaabaadka bangiga, lacagta caddaanka ah ee gacanta ku jirta, iyo kaydka dareeraha ah.
so.zakat.fieldHint.stocks: Qiimaha suuqa ee hadda jira ee saamiyada, lacagaha, iyo maalgashiga la midka ah.
so.zakat.fieldHint.business: Qiimaha badeecada, alaabada, iyo alaabta iibka loo haysto.
so.zakat.fieldHint.receivables: Amaahda iyo qaansheegyada aad si macquul ah u filayso inaad ururiso.
so.zakat.fieldHint.debts: Amaahda shakhsi ahaaneed, kaararka deynta, iyo biilasha hadda - maaha wadarta amaahda guryaha ee muddada-dheer ilaa uu u ogolaado aqoonyahankaaga.
so.zakat.fieldHint.nisab: Bannaanka ku dhaaf si aad u isticmaasho xadka la xisaabiyay, ama geli caadada nisab.

so.travel.jam.body: Qofka socotada ah wuxuu isku dari karaa Dhuxul iyo Casar hal fadhi, iyo Maghrib iyo Isha hal fadhi - isagoo labada salaadood ee fard dib u soo celinaya hal adhan iyo ciqaamo. Fajar laguma dari karo salaad kale. Isku darka waa tanaasul ka duwan gaabin: waxaa laga yaabaa inaad soo gaabiso adigoon isku darin, isku dar adiga oo aan gaabin (xaaladaha qaarkood), ama labadaba wada samee.
so.travel.jamTypes.body: Jam' al-Taqdim (isku-darka hore): labada salaadood wada tukada wakhtiga salaadda hore - tusaale; Dhuxul iyo Casar waqtiga Dhuxul. Jam' al-Taakhir (isku darka dib u dhaca): ku tukada labadaba wakhtiga salaadda dambe - tusaale; Dhuxul iyo Casar xilliga Casar. Nabiga ﷺ wuxuu isku darsamay Carafa (Dhuxur saacaddii Casar) iyo Muzdalifah (Maghrib waqtiga Cisha), isagoo labada noocba soo dhisay.
so.travel.when.title: Marka heshiisyadu bilaabmaan & dhammaadaan
so.travel.when.body: Lacag dhimashadu waxay bilaabmaysaa markaad ka tagto magaaladaada ama magaaladaada safar - maaha safar maalinle ah gudaha degaankaaga. Waxay dhamaanayaan markaad guriga ku soo laabato, ama markaad doonayso inaad joogtid meeshaad u socotay muddada ay culimadu ku qeexeen 'dejinta' (tirada maalmaha way ku kala duwan yihiin dugsiyada). Haddii aadan hubin in aad weli ku xisaabtamayso socdaale, weydii aqoonyahan ka hor intaadan u qaadan tanaasulka.
so.travel.distance.title: Fogaanta safarka
so.travel.distance.body: Culimada badankoodu waxay u baahan yihiin masaafo socdaal oo ugu yar ka hor inta aanay Qasr iyo Jam' codsan - badiyaa lagu tilmaamo qiyaastii 80 km (48 mayl), ama qiyaastii laba maalmood oo socod lug ah. Dugsiyada qaarkood waxay ka cabbiraan dhismayaashii ugu dambeeyay ee qofka magaalada; kuwa kale waxay isticmaalaan marin gaaban. Appku tan adiga kuguma xisaabinayo - ogow shuruudaha dugsigaaga oo ku dabaq hagidda aqoonyahanka.
so.travel.sunnah.title: Salaadda sunnaha marka la safarro
so.travel.sunnah.body: Salaadaha sunnaha ah ee la xoojiyay (rawaatib) ka hor iyo ka dib ayaa ah kuwo suubban laakiin looma baahna. Culumo badan ayaa fasaxa in ay ka tagaan marka ay safarka ku jiraan dhibaato darteed, gaar ahaan marka ay isku daraan salaadaha. Salaanta masjidka (taxiyatul masjid) iyo salaadaha kale ee iskaa wax u qabso ah waa la ogolyahay markasta oo aad waqti iyo tamar hesho.
so.travel.witr.body: Witr waa sunnah mu'akkadah (si adag loo adkeeyay) mana aha in laga tagin marka la safrayo. Tuko cisha ka dib - xitaa haddii aad isku dartid Maghrib iyo Isha - sida hal, saddex, ama ka badan oo rakcyo ah sida aad maamuli karto. Haddii aad ka baqeyso inaad seexato cishaha ka hor markaad safar ku jirto, nabigu ﷺ wuu fasaxay inaad ku tukato Witr ka hor ka dib markii la isku daray Maghrib-cisha.
so.travel.disclaimer: Tani waa nuxur waxbarasho, ee maaha fatwo qofeed. Xadka fogaanta, muddada joogitaanka, isku darka xeerarka, iyo in Jam' ay ku kooban tahay baahidu way ku kala duwan yihiin afarta dugsi - la tasho aqoonyahan aqoon u leh safarkaaga.
so.travel.clearExcused: Dib u bilaw raadraaca waajibka ah
so.salahGuide.title: Baro Saalax
so.salahGuide.subtitle: Laga soo bilaabo salaaddaada kowaad ilaa cibaadada joogtada ah - talaabo talaabo
so.salahGuide.intro: Safarkaaga waxbarasho: Maxaad u tukataa → Diyaarso → Baro → Ku celceli → qumman → Noqo mid joogto ah. Cashar kastaa waxa uu soo daliishanayaa Qur’aanka kariimka ah ama xadiis saxiix ah oo xidhiidh la leh Muniib raadraacayaasha.

so.salahGuide.disclaimer: Hage kooban oo ku saabsan waxbarashada iyo dib u eegis. Xaaladaada, la tasho macalin aqoon leh.

so.prayerInfo.infoHint: Wuxuu furaa tafaasiisha, faa'iidooyinka, iyo tixraacyada
so.prayerInfo.tahajjud.summary: Salaadda habeenka oo la tukaday saddex meelood oo u dambeeya habeenka, ka hor Fajriga.
so.prayerInfo.tahajjud.why: Eebe wuxuu ku soo degaa samada ugu hoosaysa sadexda danbe ee habeenka wuxuuna waydiinayaa cida u baryi doonta. Rasuulku ﷺ wuxuu si joogto ah u tukan jiray habeenkii xitaa haddii ay ikhtiyaar u tahay isaga.
so.prayerInfo.tahajjud.benefits: Wuxuu u soo dhowaadaa Eebbe, qalbiguna wuu jilciyaa, wuxuuna ahaa caadadii kuwii xaqa ahaa ee isaga ka horreeyey. Waqti ducada si gaar ah looga jawaabo.
so.prayerInfo.fajr.summary: Salaadda Subax - waa tan koowaad ee shanta salaadood ee waajibka ah.
so.prayerInfo.fajr.why: Eebe wuxuu amray in lagu oogo salaadda cidhifyada maalinta; Fajr waxay astaan ​​u tahay curashada maalinta muslimiinta, waligiisna Nabigu ﷺ kama tegin jameeco ama kaligiis.
so.prayerInfo.fajr.benefits: Qofkii tukada fajar Alle ayaa ilaalinaya. Malaa'igta habeenka iyo maalinta ayaa markhaati ka ah oo soo saarta iftiinka maalinta inteeda kale.
so.prayerInfo.sunrise.summary: Waqtiga qorraxdu ka soo baxdo cirifka sare - calaamad waqti, ma aha salaadda lafteeda.
so.prayerInfo.sunrise.why: Salaaddu waa xaaraan marka ay cadceedu soo baxayso (iyo marka ay sartu ka sii dhacayso iyo marka ay dhacaysoba) sidaa awgeed uma eka kuwa cadceed caabuda. Ogaanshaha qorrax soo baxa waxa ay caawisaa wakhtiga Isxaaq iyo in laga fogaado wakhtiyada salaada ee aan sax ahayn.
so.prayerInfo.sunrise.benefits: In la fiirsado calaamooyinka Alle ee cirka waxa ay kordhisaa cabsida (taqwa) waxa ayna ka caawisaa in salaadaha sunnada ee subaxa si sax ah loo habeeyo.
so.prayerInfo.ishraq.summary: Salaad sunne ah oo laba rakco ah ka dib markii ay qorraxdu si buuxda u soo baxday (qiyaastii 15-20 daqiiqo ka dib qorrax soo baxa).
so.prayerInfo.ishraq.why: Rasuulku (scw) wuxuu yidhi qofkii tukada fajar isagoo jamaaco ah markaas fadhiista isagoo xusa Eebbe ilaa qorrax ka soo baxa, markaas tukaday laba rakcadood, wuxuu helayaa ajar xaj iyo cumro dhammaystiran.
so.prayerInfo.ishraq.benefits: Abaal marin aad u weyn oo leh dadaal yar marka lagu daro Fajr jameecada. Si nabad ah oo maalinta ku bilowda zikri iyo salaad ikhtiyaari ah.
so.prayerInfo.duha.summary: Salaadda casar - caadiyan laba ilaa siddeed rakcadood inta u dhaxaysa qorrax ka soo baxa iyo Dhuxarka.
so.prayerInfo.duha.benefits: Wuxuu dhaafaa dambiyada, wuxuu keenaa rizqi (rizq), wuxuuna nooleeyaa sunno la dayacay. Waqtiga dabacsanaantu wuxuu ka dhigayaa mid la heli karo marka maalinta ay ogolaato.
so.prayerInfo.dhuhr.summary: Salaadda duhurnimada - salaadda labaad ee waajibka ah, marka qorraxdu dhaafto heerkeeda.
so.prayerInfo.dhuhr.why: Shanta salaadood waxa la waajibiyay Safarka Habeenka; Dhuxur waxay jebisaa mashquulka maalinta xuska Alle.
so.prayerInfo.dhuhr.benefits: Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu yidhi camalka ugu horreeya ee la xukumo maalinta qiyaame waa salaadda. Ilaalinta Dhuxuurta waxay ilaalinaysaa camalka intiisa kale.
so.prayerInfo.asr.summary: Salaaddii casar - salaadda dhexe ayaa lagu xoojiyay Qur'aanka.
so.prayerInfo.asr.why: Alle waxa uu si gaar ah uga digay ilaalinta salaadda dhexe (Salat al-Wusta). Waxay ku dhacdaa marka qaar badani ay mashquulaan ama daalaan, markaa ilaalinteeda waxay calaamad u tahay daacadnimada.
so.prayerInfo.asr.benefits: Qofkii Casar ka baaqdana waxa uu la mid yahay in uu qoyskiisii iyo maalkiisa ka lumay – taas oo muujinaysa culayskeeda. Ilaalintu waxay xoojisaa anshaxa maalinta oo dhan.
so.prayerInfo.maghrib.summary: Ducada qorrax dhaca - ayaa isla markiiba la tukaday ka dib markay qorraxdu dhacdo.
so.prayerInfo.maghrib.why: Waqtigu wuxuu furmaa isla marka qorraxdu dhacdo; dib u dhigista sabab la'aan waxay halis ugu jirtaa inay waydo daaqadii la door biday. Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu ka digay in la dayaco salaadda ilaa ay qorraxdu ka dhacdo.
so.prayerInfo.maghrib.benefits: Waxay calaamad u tahay mahadnaqa dhammaadka maalinta waxayna ka mid ahayd ducooyinkii ugu horreeyay ee Nebigu ﷺ ku adkeeyay asxaabtiisa.
so.prayerInfo.isha.summary: Salaadda habeenka - tan ugu dambeysa ee shanta salaadood ee waajibka ah, ka dib makhribkii wuu libdhay.
so.prayerInfo.isha.why: Wuxuu dhamaystiraa wareegga cibaadada maalinlaha ah. Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu yidhi haduu qof ku tukado cishaha jameeco, waxay la mid tahay inuu tukaday habeen badhkii.
so.prayerInfo.isha.benefits: Waxay keentaa xasillooni hurdada ka hor, waxayna dhammaystirtaa salaadda faradka ee maalinta. Inta badan waxaa ku xiga Witr, oo ah sunnah mu'akkadah.
so.prayerInfo.witr.summary: Salaad tiro-khafis ah (badanaa hal ama saddex rakcadood) ka dib cisha ka hor Fajr - sunnah mu'akkadah, ma aha mid ka mid ah shanta salaadood ee fard.
so.prayerInfo.witr.why: Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu yidhi Alle waa Witr (Kadi) wuuna jecel yahay Witriga, ee ilaali salaadda Witriga. Waligiis kama tegin, xitaa marka uu safrayo.
so.prayerInfo.witr.benefits: Astaan gaar ah oo ka mid ah habeenka mu'miniinta. Maalinta oo lagu xidho salaad tiro-ka- duwan waxay la socotaa magacyada Eebe iyo ku dhaqanka joogtada ah ee Nabiga.
so.prayerInfo.tahiyyatul_masjid.summary: Laba rakcadood oo salaama masjidka marka la gelayo, ka hor inta aan la fadhiisan.
so.prayerInfo.tahiyyatul_masjid.why: Marka midkiin soo galo masjidka, ha ku tukado laba rakcadood ka hor inta aanu fadhiisan - waa dardaaran toos ah oo Nabiga ﷺ.
so.prayerInfo.tahiyyatul_masjid.benefits: Waxay sharfaan baytka Alle, waxayna u diyaarisaa qalbiga jamaacada ama cibaadada gaarka ah, waxayna ku beddeshaa fadhi la'aan iyo wanaag degdeg ah.
so.prayerInfo.hajat_istikhara.summary: Ducada ikhtiyaariga ah ee baahiyaha gaarka ah (Salat al-Xajah) iyo raadinta hanuunka Alle (Salat al-Istikhara).
so.prayerInfo.hajat_istikhara.why: Istikhara waa in aad Alle weydiisato in uu kheyr kuu dooro marka aad la kulanto go'aan. Xajku waa in qofku u bandhigo baahidiisa Alle ducada ka hor ama garabkeeda.
so.prayerInfo.hajat_istikhara.benefits: Wuxuu dhisaa talo saarashada Alle (tawakkul) beddelkii welwelka oo keliya. Istikhara waxay keentaa caddayn; Xaajadu waxay caabudaysaa codsi dhab ah - Eebbana wuu ajiibaa kuwa barya.

so.travel.title: Socdaalka & ducada
so.travel.subtitle: Qasriga, Jam', iyo waxa Qur'aanku iyo Sunnadu ka sheegaan salaadda safarka
so.travel.takeaway: Eebe wuxuu sharciyeeyey gaabinta (Qasr) iyo isku-darka (Jamco) naxariista musaafurka-- in aan laga tegin salaadda, laakiin si loo fududeeyo waxqabadkeeda waddada.
so.travel.obligationsTitle: Waxa aad weli masuul ka tahay
so.travel.rakatsNote: Kaliya fard ayaa la tusay. Sunnah rawatib iyo Witr ayaa hoos looga hadlay - waa lagu talinayaa, in kasta oo safarro badan ay u fududeeyaan dhibaatada.
so.travel.qasr.title: Qasr - gaabin
so.travel.qasr.body: Afarta rakcadood ee salaadaha faradka ah - Dhuxur, Casar, iyo Isha - waxa lagu tukaday laba rakcadood oo safar is-reeb ah ku jira. Si sax ah ugu tuko sida labada rakcadood ee ugu horreeya guriga: akhrinta taagan, hal rukumo, laba sujuud, tashahud, iyo salaam. Fajar laba rakcadood ayay fadhidaa, Maghrib-na saddex; midna lama soo gaabiyo. Qasr waxay quseysaa fardka kaliya.
so.travel.jam.title: Jam' - isku darka
so.salahGuide.lessonsHint: Calaamadee mawduucyada inay dhammaystiran yihiin markaad dhammayso daraasaddooda
so.salahGuide.journey.whyHint: Ujeedada, muhiimadda, iyo cidda ay tahay inay tukadaan
so.salahGuide.journey.prepareHint: Xaaladaha, taharah, wuduuga, dharka, waqtiyada, qiblada
so.salahGuide.journey.learnHint: Adhan, tallaabo-tallaabo salah, iyo boos kasta
so.salahGuide.journey.practiceHint: Khaladaadka caadiga ah iyo ku dhaqanka sunnada
so.salahGuide.journey.consistencyHint: Noocyada Salax, Jameecada, Qaza, iyo Salada kadib
so.salahGuide.progress.salahHint: Salaada Fardowsa ayaa maanta la soo gaba gabeeyay
so.salahGuide.progress.streakHint: Maalmo xiriir ah oo salah la soo galay
so.salahGuide.progress.khushuHint: Ka fiirso joogitaanka wadnaha salaadda ka dib

so.battles.title: Dagaalada Islaamka
so.battles.subtitle: Taariikhda dhabta ah, macnaha guud, duruustii, iyo natiijooyinkii dagaaladii waaweynaa ee Islaamka hore
so.battles.intro: Duruusta → Dagaalada → Anshaxa → Casharrada. so.prophets.subtitle: Noloshii, risaaladii, iyo duruustii nabiyada lagu magacaabay Qur'aanka
so.prophets.intro: Nebi kastaa wuxuu u yeedhay tawxiidka iyo nolosha xaqa ah. Sheekooyinka waxaa laga soo xigtay Qur'aanka iyo Sunnada saxda ah - si loo milicsado, maaha madadaalo.
so.prophets.timelineHint: Dulmar taariikhi ah oo xiriir la leh mowduucyada nebiga
so.events.descriptions.mawlid: 12-ka bisha Rabii al-Awwal ayaa si weyn loola xiriirinayaa dhalashadii Nebi Muxamed ﷺ (taariikhda saxda ah waxay ka doodaan taariikhyahannada). Muslimiinta caalamka oo dhan way jecel yihiin oo way sharfeen isaga, waxaana la faray inay u duceeyaan korkiisa (Qur'an 33:56). In la qabto xaflad sanadle ah oo loo qoondeeyay (Mawliid) waa qodob ay ku kala duwan yihiin culimada guud: qaar badan, gaar ahaan suufiyada iyo dhaqamada soo jireenka ah, waxay ogolaadaan ama dhiirigeliyaan isu imaatinka xuska iyo dirida salawaatka, halka qaar kalena (oo ay ugu weyn tahay dhaqanka Salafiyada) ay qabaan in xuska sanadlaha ah ee go’an aanay ku dhaqmin jiilasha hore sidaas darteedna ay tahay in laga fogaado. Appkan waxa uu soo bandhigayaa maalinta si dhexdhexaad ah; Salawaatka oo la badiyo iyo Sunnada Nabiga oo la raaco waa alaabo la isku raacay.
so.events.descriptions.isra: Al-Isra wa al-Mi'raj waxa ay xusaysaa Safarkii Habeenka ee Mucjisada ahaa ee Nabiga ﷺ ee Makkah ku soo aadey Qudus (al-Aqsa) iyo koritaankiisii Samada, sida ku xusan Qur'aanka kariimka 17: 1 iyo 53. Habeenkan waxaa la faral yeelay shanta salaadood - asal ahaan konton, ka dibna laga dhigay shan Naxariista Eebbe ee Sacfah al-Aqsah 3 ayaa ka hadhay ajarkoodii. Habeenku wuxuu xaqiijinayaa xurmada al-Aqsa iyo dhexda Saalax. Taariikhdeeda saxda ah (oo inta badan la geliyo 27 Rajab) ma aha mid sugan, mana jiro cibaado gaar ah oo si dhab ah ugu xidhan habeenka laftiisa; shanta salaadood oo la dhawro waa casharkeeda waara.
so.events.descriptions.ramadan: Bisha sagaalaad iyo tiirka afraad ee Islaamka. Soonka laga bilaabo waaberiga ilaa qorrax dhaca wuxuu ku waajibayaa qof kasta oo Muslim ah oo qaangaar ah (Qur'an 2:183-185). Waa bishii Qur'aanka markii ugu horreysay la soo dejiyay (Qur'aanka 2:185). Rasuulku (scw) waxa uu yidhi, “Qofkii Ramadaan u sooma iimaan iyo ajar doon waxa loo dhaafaa dambigiisii ​​hore” (Saxiixul Bukhaari 38). Habeenka waxa lagu raaxaystaa salaadda taraawiixda, tobanka maalmood ee u dambeeyana waxa ay xambaarsan tahay Laylatul Qadriga. Waa bil Soon, Qur’aan, Sadaqo iyo Alle loogu dhawaanayo.
so.events.descriptions.laylatQadr: Habeenka xukunka - "ka wanaagsan kun bilood" (Qur'an 97: 3), habeenkii Qur'aanka wuxuu bilaabay inuu soo dago. Cibaadada korkeeda waxay ka miisaan badan tahay cimriga oo ka badan saddex iyo siddeetan sano. Rasuulku (scw) wuxuu yidhi, “Qofkii u istaaga (salaada) Laylatul-Qadriga iimaan dartiis oo ajar doon ah waxaa loo dhaafaa dambigiisii ​​hore” (Saxiix al-Bukhaari 1901). Habeenkeeda saxda ah waa qarsoon yahay; ka raadi habeennada qallafsan ee tobanka dambe ee Ramadaan - 21-ka, 23-aad, 25-ka, 27-aad, iyo 29-aad (Saxiixul-Bukhaari 2017), iyadoo 27-ka si gaar ah loo rajaynayo. Habeenadan ku bixi salaad, Qur'aan iyo duco: "Allaahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'anni."
so.events.descriptions.eidFitr: Munaasabadda Afurka oo ku beegan 1-da bisha Shawaal, ayaa waxay ku beegan tahay dhamaadka bisha Ramadaan. Maalinta waxa ay ku bilaabataa salaada ciida waxaana ka horeeya sakaatul fidri oo ah sadaqo la bixiyo salaada ka hor si dadka masaakiinta ah ay iyaguna u farxaan. Muslimiintu waxay akhriyaan takbiirta, waxay xidhaan sida ugu fiican, waxay isweydaarsadaan salaanta, waxayna xoojiyaan xiriirka qoyska iyo bulshada. Soonka waa xaaraan maalintan (Saxiix al-Bukhaari 1991) — waa maalin mahad naq iyo damaashaad la fasaxay cibaadada la dhameeyay Ramadaanka.
so.events.descriptions.arafah: 9-ka bisha Dul-Xijja oo ah maalinta ugu weyn ee xajka, marka ay xujaydu u istaagaan cibaadada bannaanka Carafo - "Xajku waa Carrafo." Waxay ku beegan tahay tobanka maalmood ee barakaysan ee ugu horreeya Dul-Xijja, maalmo ay camalka suuban Eebbe uga jecel yihiin kuwa kale (Saxiixul Bukhaari 969). Kuwa aan xajka soomin, soonka maalintan aad bay ugu dardaaran tahay: waxay ka dhaaftaa dunuubta sannadkii hore iyo sanadka soo socda (Saxiix Muslim 1162). Xujayda laftoodu ma soomaan, si ay u helaan tabar ay ku istaagaan iyo baryada.

so.events.descriptions.newYear: Kowda bisha Muxaram waxa ay furmaysaa sanadka Hijriyada, oo ay tiradiisu ka bilaabato Hijradii Nabiga (Hijriyada) ee Makkah una hijrooday Madiina. Muxaram waa mid ka mid ah afarta bilood ee xurmada leh, Rasuulkuna ﷺ wuxuu ugu yeeray "Bisha Alle," isagoo ku magacaabay soonkeeda ugu kheyrka badan Ramadaan ka dib (Saxiix Muslim 1163). Waa wakhti dib loo milicsado sannadkii tagay oo la cusboonaysiiyo niyada wanaagsan. Ma jiro caado gaar ah oo loo xilsaaray maalinta lafteeda, markaa iska jir dhaqamada "Sannadka Cusub" ee aan sal lahayn; soonka is-xilqaanka ah ee bisha oo dhan sii kordhaya waa sunnada la aasaasay.
so.events.descriptions.ashura: 10-ka Muxaram. Nebigu (scw) wuxuu arkay Yuhuuddii reer Madiina oo soomaysa iyagoo u mahadnaqaya Eebbe ka badbaadiyay Muuse iyo reer Banii Israa’iil Fircoon, wuxuuna ku yidhi, “Annagu Muuse adigaa kaa xaq badan,” dabadeedna way soomeen oo Muslimiinta u sheegay inay soomaan (Saxiixul Bukhaari 2004). Soonka Ashuraa waxa uu kafaaraa dunuubta yaryar ee sanadkii hore (Saxiix Muslim 1162). Si aad uga duwanaato bulshooyinka kale, waxaa lagu talinayaa in sidoo kale la soomo 9-ka (Tasuca): Nebigu ﷺ wuxuu damacsanaa inuu sidaas sameeyo sanadka soo socda (Saxiix Muslim 1134). Soonka 9-aad iyo 10-aad oo wadajira waa hab-dhaqanka la doorbido.
so.events.descriptions.eidAdha: Ciidda Sadarka oo ku beegan 10-ka bisha Dul-Xijja, ayaa ah mid ka weyn labada Ciidood, waxayna ku beegan tahay gabagabada Xajka. Waxay xusaysaa rabitaankii Nebi Ibraahim inuu u huro wiilkiisa addeecida Eebbe, kaas oo ku furtay wan (Qur'an 37: 100-107). Kuwa awooda waxay bixiyaan allabari (Udxiyah/Qurbaani), iyagoo hilibka la wadaagaya qoyska, deriska, iyo masaakiinta. Maalintu waxay ku bilaabataa salaada ciida iyo takbiirta waxayna soconaysaa ilaa sadexda maalmood ee Tashriq. Soonka waa xaaraan maalintan iyo maalmaha Tashriq (Saxiixul Bukhaari 1991).

so.jahannam.title: Fahamka Jahannam
so.jahannam.subtitle: Ogow digniinta. Dooro jidka naxariista.
so.jahannam.intro: Eebe wuxuu ku tilmaamay Jahannamo si ay quluubtu u toosaan oo ay xaggiisa ugu soo noqdaan - yaanay quusan. Digniin kastaa waxa lagu lamaanaa rajo, towbad keen, iyo talaabooyin wax ku ool ah.
so.jahannam.namesSummary: Magacyo Qur'aan ah oo macne leh
so.jahannam.namesSubtitle: Macnaha, macnaha guud, iyo qoraallada cilmiyeed
so.jahannam.namesLead: Quraanku wuxuu naarta u isticmaalaa dhawr magac. Culimadu waxay ku kala duwan yihiin in magac kastaa yahay heer gaar ah - baro macnaha qoraallada.
so.jahannam.gatesSubtitle: Maxaa waxyigu sheegay - iyo halka ay culimadu ku kala duwan yihiin
so.jahannam.gatesLead: Eebe wuxuu yidhi naarta waxay leedahay todobo albaab oo mid walba leeyahay qayb loo asteeyey. Tafsiirrada dambe ee dembiilayaasha ka soo galaan iridda ay yihiin aragtiyo cilmi, ma aha caqiido loo wada dhan yahay.

so.jahannam.hadithLead: Xadiiska waxa lagu soo bandhigaa ururin, xigasho, iyo darajo halka lagu yaqaan.
so.jahannam.duasSubtitle: Ka salah, Xisnul Muslim, iyo Qur'aanka

so.jahannam.reflectionLead: Hakin oo is weydii su'aalahan. Taabo saf si aad u furto raadraacaha ama casharka laxidhiidha.

so.hayd.duration.body:
Hayd waa dhiigbaxa billaha ah ee joogtada ah ee dumarka badankoodu dareemaan wakhti la yaqaan wareeg kasta. Culimadu waxay ka hadlaan muddada ugu yar iyo ugu badan; tirooyinka caanka ahi waxay u dhexeeyaan qiyaastii 10 ilaa 15 maalmood iyadoo madhhabku ku xiran yahay.

Qor caadadaada: inta maalmood ee haydku caadi ahaan socdo iyo goorta uu bilaabmo. Haddii dhiigbaxu dhaafo muddada hayd ee ugu badan ee madhhabkaaga, maalmaha dheeraadka ahi waxay noqon karaan istihada; xukunnada Salah iyo soonku way is beddelaan marka haydku dhammaado.
so.hayd.istihada.body:
Istihada waa dhiigbax ka baxsan wakhtiga haydka caadiga ah — inta u dhexaysa wareegyada ama marka dhiigbaxu dhaafo muddada haydka ugu badan.

Si ka duwan haydka, istihadu ma qaaddo waajibka Salah iyo soonka. Haweeneyda istihadu ku dhacdo badanaa waxay u waysaysataa Salah kasta inta dhiigbaxu socdo; culimo badani waxay qabaan in dhiigbaxa laftiisu aanu wudu jebin.

Kala saaridda haydka iyo istihada way adkaan kartaa. Haddii aadan hubin, jooji raadraaca waajibka ah keliya marka aad hubto inuu yahay hayd, xaaladdaadana kala tasho caalim aqoon leh.
so.hayd.nifas.body:
Nifas waa dhiigbaxa dhalmada ka dib. Xeerarka guud ee haydka ayaa khuseeya: Salah iyo soon lama sameeyo inta nifasku jiro, soonka Ramadan ee maqanina dambe ayaa la gudaa — Salahyada ma aha.

Muddada ugu badan waxay ku kala duwan tahay madhhabka; 40 maalmood ayaa si caadi ah loo sheegaa. Marka nifasku dhammaado, qubays waajib ah samee oo dib ugu noqo cibaadada.
so.hayd.purity.body:
Marka hayd ama nifas dhammaado, qubays buuxa samee ka hor intaadan Salah ku noqon. Soonka ku noqo haydka ka dib; soon kasta oo Ramadan ah oo hayd ku maqnaa waa in maalmo kale la gudo.

Salahyada hayd ku maqan lama gudo — Alle ayaa waajibkaas qaaday. Qubayska ka dib, ku noqo cibaadadaadii caadiga ahayd iyo raadraaca waajibka ah ee app-ka.
so.sick.title: Xanuun iyo Salah
so.sick.positions.body:
Asalku waa in Salah lagu tukado taagan iyadoo rukuuc iyo sujuud buuxa la samaynayo. Haddii istaaggu keeno xanuun daran, tabar-darro ama waxyeello, fadhi ku tuko.

Haddii aadan si toosan u fadhiisan karin, dhinac ama dhabarka u jiifso oo madaxa ku tilmaam rukuucda iyo sujuudda. Isticmaal fududayn kasta ka hor intaadan Salah gebi ahaan ka tegin.

Haddii xanuun ama waxyeello darteed aadan biyo ugu waysaysan karin, samee tayammum marka shuruudihiisu buuxsamaan.
so.sick.rukuSujud.body:
Marka aadan rukuuc buuxa samayn karin, madaxa u foorari rukuucda, sujuuddana si ka badan u foorari. Tani waa fududaynta salaadda fadhiga ama jiifka.

Haddii aadan madaxa dhaqaajin karin, culimadu waxay ku kala duwan yihiin dhaqdhaqaaqa ugu yar. Ha ka tegin Salah dhan haddii aad ku tukan karto dhaqdhaqaaqyo yaryar; Nabigu ﷺ wuxuu na baray inaan fududaynta tallaabo tallaabo u adeegsanno.
so.sick.unable.body:
Haddii aad miyir beelid, hurdo qoto dheer ku jirto inta Salah socoto, ama aad aad u xanuunsato oo aadan ku tukan karin xataa fududayn kasta, markaas waqtigeedu gudbo, dembi ma jiro balse waa in Qaza la gudo marka aad bogsato.

Maalin cudurdaaran (xanuun) oo app-ka lagu calaamadeeyo waxay hakisaa raadraaca waajibka ah oo ilaalisaa taxanahaaga; ma beddesho waajibka Qaza ee dambe.

Xanuun joogto ah, ka baro caalim aqoon leh fududaynta joogtada ah ee xaaladdaada.
so.sick.fastingQaza.body:
Haddii soonka Ramadan xanuunkaaga sii darayo ama bogsashada dib u dhigayo, soonka jebiso oo maalmo kale gudo markaad bogsato — Qur'aanku si cad ayuu ugu fasaxay bukaanka.

Soon kasta oo Ramadan ah oo maqnaada waxaa lagu gudiyaa hal maalin oo dambe; kaffaarah ma jiro ilaa soonka loo jebiyey cudurdaar sax ah la'aan.

Salahyada xanuunka ku maqan sidoo kale waa in la gudo marka aad awooddo, si kala horreeya. Marka aad bogsato, ku noqo raadraaca caadiga ah oo Qaza ku gud xawaare waara.

uz.zakat.sectionInfo.metals.body: Nisob og'irligi bo'yicha sunnatda belgilangan: taxminan 20 dinor oltin yoki 200 dirham kumush (odatda ~87,5 g oltin yoki ~612 g kumush deb ataladi). Karat va poklik muhim, chunki zakot sof metall tarkibiga kiradi. Jonli narxlar har gramm uchun 24 ming nozik metall uchun - birlik (gram, tola, troy oz) va karatni tanlang, shunda kalkulyator to'g'ri konvertatsiya qiladi.
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.metals.title: Og'irligi bo'yicha oltin va kumush
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.nisab.body: Nisob - mol-mulkning zakot muddati kelishidan oldingi eng kam ortig'idir. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam uni 20 dinor oltin yoki 200 dirham kumush qilib belgilab, moldan bir yil o'tmaguncha zakot berilmasligini ta'kidlaganlar. Bugungi kunda oltin va kumush narxlari turlicha bo'lganligi sababli, ko'plab olimlar pastroq (ko'pincha kumush) chegarani afzal ko'rishadi, shuning uchun ko'proq kambag'allarga yordam beriladi. Ushbu kalkulyator ikkita jonli taxminning eng pastini taklif qiladi.
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.nisab.title: Nisob ostonasi
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.property.body: Sizning shaxsiy uyingiz, shaxsiy avtomobilingiz va oddiy uy-ro'zg'or buyumlari odatda zakot qilinmaydi - zakot foydalanish uchun emas, balki boylikni oshirishga qaratilgan. Investitsiyalar, sotish yoki savdo qilish uchun mo'ljallangan uchastkalar, uylar yoki transport vositalari bozor qiymati bo'yicha (yoki bo'lib-bo'lib to'langan investitsiya uchastkalari bo'yicha to'langan summalar) kiritilishi mumkin. Ishonchingiz bo'lmasa, olimdan so'rang.

uz.zakat.sectionInfo.agriculture.body: Ekinlarning zakoti qamariy yildan keyin emas, balki o'rim-yig'im paytida beriladi. Hammaga ma'lum bo'lgan ko'rsatkich er yomg'ir yoki buloqlar bilan sug'orilganda 10% (ushr), sug'orish uchun kuch yoki pul sarflanganda 5% ni tashkil qiladi. Bu mavsumda hosilning bozor qiymatini kiriting va vaziyatingizga mos keladigan suv manbasini tanlang.
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.agriculture.localRefEx: And He is the One Who produces gardens, trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [flavours], and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of their fruit when they bear fruit, and give its due on the day of its harvest…
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.agriculture.title: Qishloq xo'jaligi va hosil (ushr)
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.currency.body: Zakot molingizning bozor qiymatidan siz tushunadigan valyutada hisoblanadi. Spot oltin va kumush narxlari nisob va metall qiymatlarini baholashga yordam beradi - ular sizning olimingiz tomonidan qo'llaniladigan mahalliy bozor narxlarining o'rnini bosmaydi.
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.currency.title: Valyuta va kurslar
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.deductions.body: Zakot zakot beriladigan sof boylikdir. Hozirda to'lanishi kerak bo'lgan zudlik bilan qarzlar odatda 2,5% qo'llanilishidan oldin ushlab qolinadi. Uzoq muddatli ipoteka kreditlari yanada ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'rib chiqiladi - ko'plab zamonaviy olimlar butun balansni emas, balki faqat kelgusi yil to'lovlarini olib qo'yishadi. Darhol to'lanishi kerak bo'lgan yashash xarajatlari faqat sizning olimingiz ruxsat bergan taqdirdagina ruxsat etiladi.
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.deductions.title: Chegirmalar
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.investments.body: O'sish uchun mo'ljallangan savdo mollari, tovarlari va boyliklari odatda bugungi bozor qiymatida zakot qilinadi. Aktsiyalar va fondlar odatda savdo boyligi kabi baholanadi. Siz yig'ishni kutayotgan kuchli debitorlik qarzlari ko'pincha kiritilgan. Qur'oni Karim 2:267-oyat, topgan narsangizning yaxshiligidan sarflashga chaqiradi - zakot xurmongizni halollik bilan qadrlang.
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.investments.title: Investitsiyalar va biznes
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.liquid.body: Naqd pullar, bankdagi qoldiqlar, boylik sifatida saqlanayotgan oltin yoki kumushlar zakot qilinadigan narsalardandir. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam oltin va kumushga haq to'lash haqida qattiq ogohlantirdilar. Oddiy foydalanish uchun taqiladigan zargarlik buyumlari maktablar o'rtasidagi ma'lum farqdir - mazhabingizga amal qiling. Bu yerda siz pul qiymatini kiritishingiz yoki keyingi bo'limda metallarni og'irlik bo'yicha hisoblashingiz mumkin.
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.liquid.title: Naqd pul va qimmatbaho metallar
uz.zakat.sectionInfo.livestock.body: Erkin boqiladigan qo'ylar, echkilar, qoramollar va tuyalarning o'z sunnat tarozilari va hayvon nisoblari (masalan, 40 qo'y, 30 qoramol, 5 tuya) bor - 2,5% pul stavkasi emas. uz.zakat.guide.recipients.body:
Zakot faqat Tavba surasida (9:60) Alloh taoloning O'zi zikr qilgan kishilarga berilishi mumkin. Bu bir necha ibodatlardan biri bo'lib, qabul qiluvchilar vahiy orqali sobit bo'ladi, beruvchining ixtiyoriga qoldirilmaydi. Sakkiz toifa: faqirlar (al-fuqaro); muhtojlar (al-masakin); zakotni yig'ish va tasarruf etishda band bo'lganlar; qalblari isloh qilinadiganlar (al-muallafa); asir va qullikdagilarni ozod qilish (fi'r-riqob); qarzdor (al-g'arimin); Alloh yo'lida (fi sabil Alloh); va adashgan sayohatchi (ibn as-sabil).

Sakkiztasiga ham berish shart emas; Zakotingizni bir toifaga ham berish farzni ado etadi va uni kambag'al va miskinlarga yo'naltirish eng keng tarqalgan amaldir.

Kim qabul qilmasligi ham muhim. Zakotni boylarga ham, siz boqish shart bo'lgan kishilarga ham - ota-onangizga, farzandlaringizga yoki turmush o'rtog'ingizga berilmaydi, chunki ularni qo'llab-quvvatlash baribir sizning burchingizdir. Klassik nuqtai nazarga ko'ra, bu umumiy xayriya emas, balki tegishli shaxsga egalik huquqining shaxsiy o'tkazilishi; ulamolar masjidlar kabi muassasalar yoki keng jamoat loyihalari Alloh yo'lida munosib bo'ladimi, degan ixtilof bor. Nabiy sollallohu alayhi vasallamning xonadoni Banu Hoshimga ham zakot sifatida berilmaydi. Qur'on toifalariga mos keladigan odamlarga ataylab qarating.
uz.zakat.guide.mistakes.body:
Hatto samimiy musulmonlar ham ko'pincha zakotning amaliy tafsilotlarini o'ylab topadilar. Umumiy xatolarni bilish to'g'ri va xotirjamlik bilan to'lashga yordam beradi.

Hawl yoki yubileyni unutish: tasodifiy vaqtda to'lash yoki yillarni o'tkazib yuborish, ajoyib majburiyatni qoldiradi. Har yili bir hijriy sanani belgilab, boyligingizni shu sanada baholang.

Boylikni noto'g'ri hisoblash: oltin yoki aktsiyalarni bugungi bozor qiymati o'rniga ularning sotib olish narxida baholash, bir nechta hisob yoki valyutadagi naqd pulni unutish yoki biznes inventarlari va sizga qarzdor bo'lgan pullarga e'tibor bermaslik. Zakot, xurmongizdagi barcha zakotlarga beriladi.

Noto'g'ri odamlarga berish: zakotni ota-onaga, bolalarga yoki siz allaqachon qo'llab-quvvatlagan turmush o'rtog'ingizga topshirish yoki uni har qanday xayrli ish uchun umumiy xayriya sifatida ko'rib chiqish. U Qur'onning sakkiz toifasidan biriga yetishi kerak.

Niyat xatolari: yil bo'yi saxiylik qilish, lekin hech qachon zakot qilishni niyat qilmaslik. Zakot ibodatdir va bu to'lov sizning farz zakotingiz ekanligiga niyat (niyhat) kerak.

Qarzlarni ortiqcha chegirib tashlash: to'liq uzoq muddatli ipotekani yoki hali qarzdor bo'lmagan kelajakdagi xarajatlarni olib tashlash, hisobni qisqartirish. Faqat real, joriy majburiyatlar zakot beriladigan boylikni kamaytiradi. Agar bularning birortasi sizning vaziyatingiz uchun tushunarsiz bo'lsa, taxmin qilishdan ko'ra malakali olimdan so'rang.
uz.zakat.guide.purpose.body:
Alloh taolo zakot haqida shunday deydi: “Ularning mollaridan sadaqa oling, bu bilan ularni poklab, oʻstiring” (9:103). Majburiyat bir vaqtning o'zida ikki darajada ishlaydi — ehson qiluvchining ruhini xasislikdan va dunyo ishqidan poklaydi va qo'lingda qolgan narsa foydali va barakali bo'lishi uchun boylikning o'zini poklaydi.

Ijtimoiy jihatdan zakot ilohiy tartibga solingan muomala tizimidir. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam Muozni Yamanga yuborganlarida, ularning boylaridan zakot olib, kambag'allariga berishni buyurdilar. Boylik bir necha kishi orasida to'planish uchun mo'ljallanmagan; zakot uni qaytadan harakatga keltiradi, shunda muhtojlar to'ydiriladi, qarzdorlar ozod bo'ladi va jamiyat rishtalari mustahkamlanadi.

Ruhiy jihatdan zakot berish shukronalik va ishonchdir. U insonning rizq-ro‘zni Alloh taolodan ekaniga ishonch bilan to‘plash istagiga javob beradi va mo‘minni berishni yaxshi ko‘rishga o‘rgatadi. Zakotni o'z ixtiyori bilan bergan kishining mollari himoyalangan, qalblari yengil va ajrlari Robbilari huzurida saqlanib qolgan bo'ladi - "Ularga qo'rquv yo'q va ular qayg'urmaslar" (Baqara surasi, 277-oyat).

uz.zakat.guide.debts.body:
Zakot sizning sof zakot boyligingizdan hisoblab chiqiladi, shuning uchun sizning haqiqiy qarzlaringiz to'lanadigan miqdorni kamaytirishi mumkin. Eng aniq holat hozirda to'lanishi kerak bo'lgan qarzlar - to'lanmagan shaxsiy kredit, kredit kartadagi to'lanmagan qoldiq, ijara yoki allaqachon qarzdorlik. Aksariyat olimlar 2,5% ni qo'llashdan oldin ularni yalpi boyligingizdan olib tashlashga ruxsat berishadi.

Ipoteka yoki ko'p yillik bo'lib-bo'lib to'lash kabi uzoq muddatli qarzlar ko'proq ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'rib chiqiladi, chunki butun qoldiqni chegirib tashlash uy krediti bo'lgan deyarli har bir kishining zakotini yo'q qiladi. Keng tarqalgan zamonaviy yondashuv - bu butun to'lanmagan summani emas, balki faqat kelgusi yil uchun to'lanishi kerak bo'lgan to'lovlarni chegirib tashlashdir. Maktablar va olimlar bu erda farq qiladi, shuning uchun rahbarlik ostida izchil usulni tanlang.

Ikkita ogohlantirish. Birinchidan, kelajakdagi yoki taxminiy xarajatlarni chegirib tashlanadigan qarzlar deb hisoblamang - faqat sizning qarzingiz hisobga olinadi. Ikkinchidan, o‘tgan yilgi to‘lanmagan zakotni oddiy qarzdek ayirmang; to'lanmagan zakot vojib bo'lib qoladi va shunchaki to'lanishi kerak. Sizning qarzingiz murakkab bo'lsa, olimning hukmi taxminiy taxmindan ko'ra qimmatroqdir.

uz.qaza.witrNote.intro: Aksariyat ulamolarning fikriga ko'ra, o'tkazib yuborilgan Witrni qazo qilish joizdir, lekin talab qilinadimi yoki yo'qmi, sizning mazhabingizga (tafakkur maktabiga) bog'liq.
uz.qaza.witrNote.hanafiBody: Witr vojib (vojib)dir. Agar uni o'tkazib yuborsangiz, uni to'ldirishingiz kerak (qaza). Esingizda bo'lsa, kunlar yoki haftalar o'tgan bo'lsa ham, darhol ibodat qiling. Janubiy Osiyo, Markaziy Osiyo va Turkiyadagi aksariyat musulmonlar shunday fikrga ega.
uz.qaza.witrNote.othersBody: Witr qattiq ta'kidlangan sunnat (sunnah mu'akkadah), farz emas. Uni to'qib qilish tavsiya qilinadi (mustahab), lekin shart emas. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam uyqu yoki kasallik tufayli qazosini qazo qilar edilar.
uz.qaza.witrNote.evidenceBody: Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam aytdilar: "Kimki uxlab qolsa va Witrni o'tkazib yuborsa yoki unutsa, eslaganida namozini o'qisin". (Termiziy, Ibn Moja — ulamolar uning bahosi boʻyicha ixtilof qilganlar.) “Sahihi Muslim”da kasallik yoki uyqu tufayli xufton namozini oʻtkazib yuborsa, kunduzi juft rakat bilan qazo qilgan.
uz.qaza.witrNote.footer: Bu ilova barcha foydalanuvchilar uchun oʻtkazib yuborilgan Witr va qaza ga toʻgʻri keladi. Agar siz Hanafi ko'rinishiga amal qilsangiz, unga kerak bo'lganda foydalaning; aks holda uni tavsiya etilgan bo'yanish sifatida kuzatib boring. Vaziyatingiz uchun olim bilan maslahatlashing.

uz.zakat.intro: Zakot Islomning uchinchi ustunidir - nisab dan yuqori bir qamariy yil uchun 2,5% shartli boylik. Quyidagi kalkulyatordan foydalaning, so'ngra to'lashdan oldin qo'llanmalar yoki nazorat ro'yxatini o'qing.
uz.zakat.takeaway: Zakot - bu boylikning majburiy tozalanishi - nisab ga yetgandan so'ng, bir qamariy yil davomida saqlanadigan shartli aktivlarning 2,5%. Bu islomning ustuni va kambag'allarning boylar ustidagi huquqidir.

uz.zakat.evidenceSubtitle: Zakotni farz qilib belgilovchi asosiy matnlar
uz.zakat.evidenceIntro: Zakot Qur'an va sunnatda ixtiyoriy sadaqa emas, balki malakali boylik bo'yicha belgilangan majburiyat sifatida belgilangan.
uz.zakat.guide.basics.body:
Zakot Islomning uchinchi ustuni bo'lib, namoz (salah) va Ramadan ro'zasi o'rtasida o'tirishdir. Qur'anda namozni o'qish va zakot berish amri bir juft bo'lib ko'p marta takrorlanadi, bu Allahga sig'inish va Uning ijodiga g'amxo'rlik birgalikda to'qilganligini ko'rsatadi. Bu ixtiyoriy sovg'a emas, balki kambag'allar boylarning boyligi ustidan egalik qiladigan qat'iy, majburiy huquqdir.

Zakot so‘zi ham poklanish, ham o‘sish ma’nosini bildiradi. Ortiqcha narsangizning ozgina, qat'iy qismini berish, qolgan boyligingiz va qalbingizni ochko'zlikdan tozalaydi va - Allah va'dasiga ko'ra - qolgan narsalarning qisqarishiga emas, balki barakada o'sishiga sabab bo'ladi.

Pul boyligining standart stavkasi qirqdan bir, ya'ni 2,5%. Shunday qilib, qamariy yilni chegaradan yuqoriroq tugatgan har 1000 ta shartli boylik uchun 25 tasi to'g'ri keladi. Bu dizayn bo'yicha kamtarona ulushdir: resurslarni beruvchini qiyinlashtirmasdan muhtojlarga tarqatish uchun etarli.

Zakot sadaqa bilan bir xil emas. Sadaqa har qanday ixtiyoriy xayriya bo'lib, har qanday miqdorda, istalgan vaqtda, deyarli har kimga beriladi. Zakot - bu ma'lum bir farz - belgilangan stavka, belgilangan boylik toifalari bo'yicha, belgilangan shartlar bajarilgandan so'ng, ma'lum toifadagi odamlarga to'lanadi. Uni ataylab e'tiborsiz qoldirish katta gunohdir; Qur'an ham, sunnat ham mol-mulkni to'plashdan, uning haqini saqlamaslikdan qattiq ogohlantiradi.

uz.zakat.guide.purpose.summary: U boylikni va qalbni poklaydi va kambag'allarni ko'taradi
uz.zakat.guide.hawl.summary: Boylik nisabdan bir Hijri yil davomida turishi kerak
uz.zakat.guide.hawl.body:
Naqd pul, oltin, kumush va savdo boyliklarining zakoti odatda Hijri (qamariy) yil davomida nisab chegarasida yoki undan yuqori bo'lgandan keyingina to'lanadi. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam mol-dunyodan bir yil o'tmaguncha zakot yo'qligini ta'kidlaganlar.

Amalda zakot beriladigan boyligingiz nisabga birinchi bo'lib yetgan sanaga e'tibor bering. Bu sana sizning yillik zakot yubileyingizga aylanadi - har yili o'sha Hijri sanasida siz o'zingizga tegishli hamma narsani qadrlaysiz va umumiy summaning 2,5 foizini to'laysiz.

Har bir tangani alohida kuzatishingiz shart emas. Aksariyat olimlarning fikriga ko'ra, sizning jami yil davomida nisab darajasida yoki undan yuqori bo'lsa, ular orasidagi kichik pasayish va ko'tarilish muhim emas - siz shunchaki yubileyingizda butun summani baholaysiz. Agar yil davomida sizning boyligingiz nisab dan butunlay pastga tushsa, ko‘pchilik olimlar hawl-ni qayta o‘rnatishni, faqat keyingi nisab ga yetganingizda qayta ishga tushirishni o‘ylashadi.

Hijri (qamariy) yil quyosh yilidan taxminan o'n bir kun qisqa ekanligini unutmang. Agar siz qulaylik uchun belgilangan Grigorian sanasida to'lashni afzal ko'rsangiz, ba'zi olimlar qisqaroq oy tsiklini hisobga olish uchun stavkani biroz oshirish sharti bilan ruxsat berishadi. Qishloq xo'jaligi mahsulotlari va chorva mollari o'zlarining vaqt qoidalariga rioya qilishadi va hawl bilan bir xil tarzda bog'lanmagan.
uz.zakat.guide.nisab.title: Nisab — minimal chegara
uz.zakat.guide.nisab.summary: ~87,5 g oltin yoki ~595-612 g kumushga nisbatan o'lchanadi
uz.zakat.guide.nisab.body:
Nisab - zakot farz bo'lgunga qadar odam egalik qilishi kerak bo'lgan eng kam boylikdir. Kimning sof boyligi yil bo'yi nisab dan past bo'lsa, zakot qarzi bo'lmasa, farz faqat haqiqiy molga ega bo'lganlargadir.

Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam chegaralarni o'z davrining pul birligida belgilab qo'yganlar: 20 dinor oltin yoki 200 dirham kumush. Og'irligida bu taxminan 85-87,5 g oltin va taxminan 595-612 g kumushga to'g'ri keladi (kichik o'zgarish dirhamning turli ilmiy konvertatsiyalarini aks ettiradi). Ushbu kalkulyator taxminan 87,48 g oltin va 612,36 g kumushning keng ko'rsatilgan raqamlaridan foydalanadi.

Oltin va kumush endi Payg'ambar davridagi nisbatda sotilmagani uchun, bu ikki chegara endi juda boshqacha pul qiymatlarini beradi - kumush nisab ancha pastroq. Shuning uchun ko'pgina zamonaviy olimlar naqd pul va aralash boylikni kumush nisab bilan o'lchashni maslahat berishadi: bu ko'proq odamlarni javobgar qiladi, lekin bu ko'proq kambag'allarga yordam berishni anglatadi, bu majburiyatning ruhidir. Boshqalar oltin nisab ga ergashadi. Ikkala pozitsiya ham hurmatga sazovor - o'z olimingizning ko'rsatmalariga amal qiling.
uz.zakat.guide.zakatable.title: Umuman zakot qilinadigan narsa
uz.zakat.guide.zakatable.summary: Naqd pul, metallar, investitsiyalar, savdo tovarlari, debitorlik qarzlari
uz.zakat.guide.zakatable.body:
Zakot siz foydalanadigan narsalardan ko'ra o'sishi mumkin bo'lgan boylikdan - pul va pul sifatida saqlanadigan narsalardan olinadi. Maktablarda kelishilgan asosiy toifalar naqd pul, oltin va kumush, savdo tovarlari va (o'z qoidalari bilan) ekinlar va chorva mollaridir.

Bugungi kunda odatda zakot qilinadi: kassadagi va bank hisobidagi naqd pul; oltin va kumush, shu jumladan quyma, tangalar va doimiy foydalanilmaydigan zargarlik buyumlari; aktsiyalar, aktsiyalar va investitsiya fondlari joriy bozor narxida baholanadi; qayta sotish bahosida baholangan korxona tovarlari va inventarlari (savdo tovarlari); kuchli debitorlik qarzlari - siz undirishni oqilona kutayotgan kreditlar va schyot-fakturalar; va ijara yoki biznes daromadi siz sarflagandan ko'ra jamg'argansiz.

Ko'pgina olimlar, shuningdek, mavjud pensiya jamg'armalari va aktiv sifatida saqlanadigan kriptovalyutalarni ham o'z ichiga oladi va ularni naqd pul yoki investitsiyalar sifatida ko'radi. Shubha tug'ilganda, yo'l-yo'riqli savol oddiy: bu boylik qiymat omborimi yoki men yo'q qila oladigan o'sish vositasimi? Agar shunday bo'lsa, zakot bo'lishi mumkin. Hamma narsani zakot kunidagi bozor narxida baholang, avval to'laganingizdan emas.
uz.zakat.guide.exempt.title: Odatda zakot qilinmaydigan narsa
uz.zakat.guide.exempt.summary: Shaxsiy foydalanish buyumlari, eskirgan zargarlik buyumlari, qulflangan pensiyalar
uz.zakat.guide.exempt.body:
Oddiy kundalik hayotingizda bog'langan boylik odatda zakot qilinmaydi, chunki zakot siz yashayotgan va foydalanadigan narsalarga emas, balki ko'payib borayotgan boylikka qaratilgan. Sizning uyingiz, mashinangiz, kiyim-kechaklaringiz, mebellaringiz, jihozlaringiz va savdo-sotiqingizning asbob-uskunalari, qanchalik qimmatli bo'lmasin, barchasi bundan mustasno.

Ayolning muntazam ravishda kiyadigan oltin va kumush zargarlik buyumlari taniqli farq nuqtasidir. Hanafi maktabi barcha oltin va kumushlarni hatto kiygan taqdirda ham zakot deb hisoblaydi; ko'pchilik - Maliki, Shafi'i va Hanbali - oddiy shaxsiy foydalanish uchun saqlanadigan zargarlik buyumlaridan ozod qilinadi, lekin agar ular boylik ombori sifatida yig'ilsa yoki odatiy bezakdan oshib ketgan bo'lsa, uni o'z ichiga oladi. O'zingiz amal qilgan maktab qaroriga rioya qiling.

Siz hali foydalana olmaydigan nafaqa yoki nafaqa fondlari ko'pincha pul sizning qo'lingizga tushmaguncha hisobga olinmaydi, garchi ba'zi olimlar kirish mumkin bo'lgan qismi uchun zakot talab qiladilar. Sizga to'lanishi mumkin bo'lmagan qarzlar odatda undirilmaguncha hisobga olinmaydi. Har doimgidek, nozik tafsilotlar maktablar orasida farq qiladi - ish noaniq bo'lsa, taxmin qilishdan ko'ra malakali olimdan so'rang.
uz.zakat.guide.debts.title: Qarzlar va ajratmalar
uz.zakat.guide.debts.summary: Darhol qarzlar 2,5% ni hisoblashdan oldin hisobdan chiqarilishi mumkin
uz.zakat.guide.otherRates.summary: Ekinlar, chorvachilik va hayit oldidan zakat al-fitr farq qiladi
uz.zakat.guide.otherRates.body:
2,5% stavka pul va savdo boyligi uchun amal qiladi - zakat al-mal, bu kalkulyator qamrab oladi. Bir nechta boshqa toifalar butunlay boshqacha qoidalar va stavkalarga ega.

Ekinlar va mevalarning zakoti bir yildan keyin emas, balki yig'ib olinganda beriladi: yomg'ir yoki buloqlar bilan tabiiy ravishda sug'oriladigan yer uchun stavka 10% (ushr) va sun'iy kuch yoki xarajat bilan sug'orilgan yer uchun 5%. Yaylov chorva mollari - yilning ko'p qismini erkin o'tlaydigan tuyalar, qoramollar, qo'ylar va echkilar - to'g'ridan-to'g'ri sunnatdan olingan o'zlarining turlari bo'yicha nisab hisoblari va toymasin tarozilariga ega.

Zakat al-fitr yana boshqacha, buni har bir musulmon bilishi kerak. Bu kichik, doimiy sadaqa - taxminan bir so' (taxminan 2,5-3 kg) xurmo, arpa, bug'doy yoki guruch kabi asosiy oziq-ovqat yoki uning pul qiymati ko'p hukmlarda - Ramadan oxirida uyning har bir a'zosi, yoshu qari nomidan. Uning maqsadi ro'zadorni har qanday kamchilikdan poklash va kambag'allarga ham Hayit bayramini nishonlash uchun oziq-ovqat bilan ta'minlashdir. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam uni Ramazon hayiti namozidan oldin berishni buyurdilar; keyin to'langan bo'lsa, u faqat oddiy xayriya hisoblanadi. Ushbu toifalarning har biri o'zining batafsil qarorlariga ega - aktivga xos bo'lgan ko'rsatmalarga murojaat qiling.

uz.events.descriptions.mawlid: Rabiul-avval oyining 12-kuni Payg'ambarimiz Muhammad sollallohu alayhi vasallamning tavallud kunlari bilan bog'liq (aniq sana tarixchilar o'rtasida bahslashadi). Musulmonlar uni sevadilar va hurmat qiladilar va unga salovat aytishga buyuriladilar (Qur'on 33:56). Har yili maxsus bayram (mavlid) o'tkazilishi yoki o'tkazilishi asosiy ulamolar bir-biridan farq qiladigan nuqtadir: ko'pchilik, ayniqsa, so'fiylik va an'anaviy urf-odatlarda, xotira yig'inlari va salovot aytishga ruxsat beradi yoki rag'batlantiradi, boshqalari (ayniqsa, salafiylik an'analarida) har yili qat'iy nishonlash erta avlodlar tomonidan amalga oshirilmasligi kerak, deb hisoblashadi. Ushbu ilova kunni neytral tarzda taqdim etadi; salovotni ko'paytirish va Payg'ambar sunnatlariga amal qilish kelishilgan narsadir.
uz.events.descriptions.isra: Al-Isro va al-Me'rojda Payg'ambarimiz sollallohu alayhi vasallamning Makkadan Quddusga (al-Aqso) mo''jizaviy tungi sayohatlari va u zotning osmonga ko'tarilishi haqida Qur'on 17:1 va 53 oyatlarida zikr qilinadi. Bu kechada besh vaqt namoz farz qilindi. (Sahih al-Buxoriy 349). Kecha al-Aqsoning muqaddasligini va namozning markaziyligini tasdiqlaydi. Uning aniq sanasi (odatda 27 rajabga to'g'ri keladi) qat'iy belgilanmagan va hech qanday maxsus ibodat kechaning o'ziga bog'liq emas; besh vaqt namozni saqlash uning doimiy saboqidir.
uz.events.descriptions.ramadan: Islomning to'qqizinchi oyi va to'rtinchi ustuni. Tongdan quyosh botguncha ro'za tutish har bir balog'atga yetgan musulmonga farzdir (Qur'on 2:183–185). Qur'on birinchi marta nozil qilingan oydir (Baqara surasi, 185-oyat). Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam aytdilar: “Kim Ramazon ro‘zasini iymon va savob uchun tutsa, uning o‘tgan gunohlari kechiriladi” (Sahih al-Buxoriy, 38). Kechalar taroveh namozi bilan jonlanadi, oxirgi o'n kunlikda esa Qadr kechasi o'tkaziladi. Bu oy ro'za, Qur'on, sadaqa va Allohga yaqinlashish oyidir.
uz.events.descriptions.laylatQadr: Qadr kechasi — "ming oydan afzal" (Qur'on 97:3), Qur'on tusha boshlagan kechadir. Unga sig'inish sakson uch yildan ortiq umr ko'radi. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam aytdilar: “Kimki Qadr kechasida iymon va savob umidida tursa, uning o‘tgan gunohlari mag‘firat qilinadi” (Sahih al-Buxoriy 1901). Uning aniq kechasi yashiringan; uni Ramazon oyining oxirgi o'nligining toq kechalarida - 21, 23, 25, 27 va 29-da (Sahih al-Buxoriy 2017), 27-ni ayniqsa umid qilgan holda qidiring. Bu kechalarni namoz, Qur'on va duo bilan o'tkazing: "Allohumma innaka afuvvun tuhibbu al-afva fa'fu anni".
uz.events.descriptions.eidFitr: Shavvol oyining 1-da ro‘za tutish bayrami Ramazon oyi tugashini bildiradi. Kun hayit namozi bilan boshlanadi va undan oldin fitr zakoti beriladi, bu namozdan oldin kambag'allar ham xursand bo'lishlari uchun beriladigan sadaqadir. Musulmonlar takbir aytadilar, qo‘llaridan kelgancha kiyinadilar, bir-birlari bilan salomlashadilar, oila va mahalla rishtalarini mustahkamlaydilar. Bu kunda ro'za tutish taqiqlangan (Sahih al-Buxoriy 1991) - bu rahmat kuni va Ramazon oyida tugallangan ibodat uchun ruxsat etilgan bayramdir.
uz.events.descriptions.arafah: Zulhijja oyining 9-kuni, hajning eng ulug‘ kuni, ziyoratchilar Arafa tekisligida sajda qilib turganlarida — “Haj – Arafadir”. Bu Zulhijja oyining muborak birinchi o'n kunligiga to'g'ri keladi, bu kunlarda solih amallar Allohga boshqalardan ko'ra sevimliroqdir (Sahih al-Buxoriy 969). Hajga bormaganlar uchun bu kunda ro‘za tutish tavsiya etiladi: o‘tgan yil va kelgusi yilning gunohlariga kafforat (Sahih Muslim 1162). Ziyoratchilarning o'zlari turish va duo qilish uchun kuchga ega bo'lish uchun ro'za tutmaydilar.
uz.prayerInfo.isha.summary: Xufton namozi - besh farz namozning oxirgisi, qorong'i tushgandan keyin.
uz.prayerInfo.isha.why: Kundalik ibodatning tsiklini yakunlaydi. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam aytdilarki, kim xuftonni jamoat bilan o‘qisa, xuddi yarim kechani o‘qigandek bo‘ladi.
uz.prayerInfo.isha.benefits: Uyqudan oldin xotirjamlik keltiradi va kunduzgi farzlarni ado etadi. Ko'pincha sunnat muakkada bo'lgan vitrdan keyin keladi.
uz.prayerInfo.witr.summary: Xuftondan keyin bomdoddan oldin toq sonli namoz (odatda bir yoki uch rakat) — sunnat muakkada, besh farz namozdan biri emas.
uz.prayerInfo.witr.why: Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam aytdilarki, Alloh vitr (yagona)dir va vitrni yaxshi ko'radi, vitr namozini o'qing. U hech qachon, hatto sayohat paytida ham uni tark etmagan.
uz.prayerInfo.witr.benefits: Mo'minning tungi tartibining o'ziga xos belgisi. Kunni toq sonli duolar bilan yakunlash Alloh taoloning ismlari va Payg'ambarning izchil amaliyotiga mos keladi.
uz.prayerInfo.tahiyyatul_masjid.summary: Masjidga kirishda, oʻtirishdan oldin ikki rakat salom berish.
uz.prayerInfo.tahiyyatul_masjid.why: Sizlardan biringiz masjidga kirsa, o'tirishdan oldin ikki rakat namoz o'qisin - bu Payg'ambar sollallohu alayhi vasallamning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatmalari.
uz.prayerInfo.tahiyyatul_masjid.benefits: Allohning uyini sharaflaydi, qalbni jamoatga yoki shaxsiy ibodatga tayyorlaydi va bekor o'tirishni darhol yaxshilik bilan almashtiradi.
uz.prayerInfo.hajat_istikhara.summary: Shaxsiy ehtiyojlar uchun ixtiyoriy duolar (Hoja namozi) va Allohning hidoyatini izlash (Istixora namozi).
uz.prayerInfo.hajat_istikhara.why: Istixora - biror qarorga duch kelganda Allohdan siz uchun yaxshilikni tanlashini so'rashdir. Haja - duodan oldin yoki duo bilan birga duo orqali Allohga ehtiyojini bildirishdir.
uz.prayerInfo.hajat_istikhara.benefits: Faqat tashvish o'rniga Allohga tavakkul (tavakkul) qiladi. Istixora ravshanlik keltiradi; Xoja ixlos bilan ibodat qiladi va Alloh taolo duo qilganlarga ijobat qiladi.

uz.travel.qasr.title: Qasr — qisqartirish
uz.travel.qasr.body: To'rt rakat farz namozlari - peshin, asr va xufton - safarda ikki rakat qilib o'qiladi. Ularni uydagi birinchi ikki rakat kabi o'qing: tik turib tilovat, bir ruku, ikki sujud, tashahhud va salom. Bomdod ikki rakat, shom esa uch rakat qoladi; ham qisqartirilmaydi. Qasr faqat farz uchun amal qiladi.

uz.prayerInfo.tahajjud.summary: Kechaning oxirgi uchdan birida, bomdoddan oldin o'qiladigan xufton namozi.
uz.prayerInfo.tahajjud.why: Alloh kechaning oxirgi uchdan birida eng past osmonga tushib, Unga kim duo qilishini so'raydi. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam kechalari ixtiyor bo'lsa ham namoz o'qirdilar.
uz.prayerInfo.tahajjud.benefits: Allohga yaqinlashtiradi, qalbni yumshatadi, Uning oldidagi solihlarning odati edi. Duo ayniqsa ijobat bo'ladigan vaqt.
uz.prayerInfo.fajr.summary: Bomdod namozi - besh vaqt farz namozning birinchisi.
uz.prayerInfo.fajr.why: Alloh kunning chetida namoz o'qishni buyurdi. Bomdod musulmonlar kunining boshlanishini bildiradi va uni Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam jamoat bilan ham, yolg'iz ham tark qilmaganlar.
uz.prayerInfo.fajr.benefits: Kim bomdod namozini o'qisa, Allohning panohida bo'ladi. Kecha va kunduzning farishtalari guvoh bo'lib, kunning qolgan qismiga yorug'lik olib keladi.
uz.prayerInfo.sunrise.summary: Quyoshning ufqdan ko'tarilishi - vaqt belgisi, ibodatning o'zi emas.
uz.prayerInfo.sunrise.why: Ummat quyoshga sig'inuvchilarga o'xshamasligi uchun quyosh chiqayotganda (va zenitda va botishda) namoz o'qish taqiqlanadi. Quyosh chiqishini bilish ishroq vaqtini o'tkazishga va noto'g'ri namoz vaqtlaridan qochishga yordam beradi.
uz.prayerInfo.sunrise.benefits: Allohning osmondagi oyatlarini kuzatish qo'rquvni (taqvoni) oshiradi va bomdod sunnat namozlarini to'g'ri tuzishga yordam beradi.
uz.prayerInfo.ishraq.summary: Quyosh toʻliq chiqqandan keyin ikki rakat sunnat namozi (quyosh chiqqandan keyin taxminan 15–20 daqiqa).
uz.prayerInfo.ishraq.why: Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam aytdilarki, kim bomdod namozini jamoat bilan o‘qisa, so‘ngra quyosh chiqquncha Allohni zikr qilib o‘tirsa, keyin ikki rakat namoz o‘qisa, to‘liq haj va umra savobini oladi.
uz.prayerInfo.ishraq.benefits: Bomdod namozini jamoat bilan birlashtirganda kam harakat bilan ulkan savob. Zikr va nafl namozda kunning tinch boshlanishi.
uz.prayerInfo.duha.summary: Peshin namozi - odatda quyosh chiqishi bilan peshin oralig'ida ikki rakatdan sakkiz rakatgacha.
uz.prayerInfo.duha.benefits: Gunohlarni kechiradi, rizq (rizq) keltiradi va beparvo qilingan sunnatni tiriltiradi. Moslashuvchan vaqt uni kun imkon berganda foydalanish imkonini beradi.
uz.prayerInfo.dhuhr.summary: Peshin namozi - ikkinchi farz namoz, quyosh zenitdan o'tganda.
uz.prayerInfo.dhuhr.why: Tungi safarda besh vaqt namoz farz qilindi; Peshin kunning bandligini Allohni zikr qilish bilan buzadi.
uz.prayerInfo.dhuhr.benefits: Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam aytdilarki, qiyomat kuni hukm qilinadigan birinchi amal namozdir. Peshinni qo'riqlash qolgan amallarini himoya qiladi.
uz.prayerInfo.asr.summary: Peshin namozi - Qur'onda ta'kidlangan o'rta namoz.
uz.prayerInfo.asr.why: Alloh taolo o'rta namozni (Vusta namozini) saqlash haqida alohida ogohlantirgan. Ko'pchilik band yoki charchagan paytda tushadi, shuning uchun uni saqlab qolish samimiylik belgisidir.
uz.prayerInfo.asr.benefits: Kimki asrni sog'inib qo'ysa, go'yo u oilasini va molini yo'qotgandek bo'ladi - uning vaznini ta'kidlaydi. Uni saqlash kun davomida intizomni mustahkamlaydi.
uz.prayerInfo.maghrib.summary: Quyosh botishi namozi - quyosh botgandan keyin darhol o'qiladi.
uz.prayerInfo.maghrib.why: Vaqt quyosh botishi bilan ochiladi; sababsiz kechiktirish afzal oynani yo'qotish xavfini tug'diradi. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam quyosh botguncha namozni tark etishdan ogohlantirdilar.
uz.prayerInfo.maghrib.benefits: Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam sahobalariga aytgan birinchi duolardan bo'lib, kun oxirida shukr qiladilar.

uz.lastDay.disclaimer: Qur'ondan ma'rifiy sharh va baholi hadis. Shaxsiy qarorlar uchun malakali olimlar bilan maslahatlashing.
uz.travel.jam.body: Yo'lovchi bir o'tirishda peshin bilan asrni, bir o'tirishda esa shom bilan xuftonni birlashtirib, bir o'tirishda har ikki farzni bir azon va iqomat bilan o'qishi mumkin. Bomdod namozini boshqa namozga qo'shib bo'lmaydi. Birlashtirish - bu qisqartirishdan alohida imtiyoz: siz birlashtirmasdan qisqartirishingiz, qisqartirmasdan birlashtirishingiz (ba'zi holatlarda) yoki ikkalasini birgalikda bajarishingiz mumkin.
uz.travel.jamTypes.body: Jam' al-taqdim (erta jamlash): oldingi namoz vaqtida ikkala namozni birga o'qing, masalan. Peshin vaqti va asr. Jam' at-Tahir (kechiktirilgan birlashma): ikkalasini ham kech namoz vaqtida o'qing - masalan. Peshin va asr asrlarida. Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam Arafada (asr vaqtidagi peshin) va Muzdalifada (Isho vaqtidagi shom) birlashdilar va ikkala shaklni ham o'rnatdilar.
uz.travel.when.title: Imtiyozlar qachon boshlanadi va tugaydi
uz.travel.when.body: Imtiyozlar sizning shahringiz yoki shahringizdan sayohatga chiqqaningizdan so'ng boshlanadi - sizning hududingizdagi kundalik qatnovlar uchun emas. Ular uyga qaytganingizdan so'ng yoki olimlar "joylashish" deb ta'riflagan muddat davomida manzilingizda qolishni niyat qilganingizda tugaydi (kunlar soni maktablarda farqlanadi). Agar siz hali ham sayohatchi hisoblanmasligingizga ishonchingiz komil bo'lmasa, imtiyozlarni qabul qilishdan oldin olimdan so'rang.
uz.travel.distance.title: Sayohat masofasi
uz.travel.distance.body: Ko'pgina olimlar Qasr va Jam' qo'llanilishidan oldin minimal sayohat masofasini talab qiladilar - odatda taxminan 80 km (48 milya) yoki piyoda ikki kunlik yo'l deb ataladi. Ba'zi maktablar o'z shahrining oxirgi binolaridan o'lchanadi; boshqalar esa qisqaroq chegaradan foydalanadilar. Ilova buni siz uchun hisoblamaydi - maktabingiz mezonini bilib oling va uni olimning ko'rsatmalari bilan qo'llang.
uz.travel.sunnah.title: Sayohat paytida o'qiladigan sunnat namozlari
uz.travel.sunnah.body: Farzdan oldin va keyin o'qilgan sunnat namozlari (ravotib) fazilatli bo'lib qoladi, lekin shart emas. Ko'pgina ulamolar qiyinchilik tufayli sayohat paytida ularni tark etishga ruxsat berganlar, ayniqsa namozni jamlaganda. Masjidga salom berish (tahiyyatul masjid) va boshqa nafl namozlarni vaqtingiz va kuchingiz bo'lganda joiz bo'lib qoladi.
uz.travel.witr.body: Vitr sunnat muakkada (qattiq ta'kidlangan) bo'lib, sayohat paytida uni tark etmaslik kerak. Xuftondan keyin, hatto shom va xuftonni birlashtirgan bo'lsangiz ham, qo'lingizdan kelganicha bir, uch yoki undan ortiq toq rakat namoz o'qing. Agar safar chog‘ida xuftondan oldin uxlab qolishdan qo‘rqsangiz, Rasululloh sollallohu alayhi vasallam vitr namozini qo‘shma shomdan keyin o‘qishga ruxsat berganlar.
uz.travel.disclaimer: Bu shaxsiy fatvo emas, ta'lim mazmuni. Masofa chegaralari, qolish muddati, qoidalarni birlashtirish va Jam'ning ehtiyoj bilan cheklanganligi to'rtta maktab o'rtasida farq qiladi - sayohatingiz uchun malakali olim bilan maslahatlashing.
